COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Success provides warning about Ysondkhelir (denizen of Leng). Floor 7 specific - devil prison guards.

COMPLICATION.title: Negotiation with Morlocks
COMPLICATION.description: A group of Morlocks emerge from the shadows, weapons ready but not attacking. They grunt and gesture - they want something. 'Ghost Queen... tribute...'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Diplomacy to negotiate, DC 17 Society to understand their culture
COMPLICATION.success: You make a deal. They want food or shiny objects. They leave you alone or provide information about nearby dangers.
COMPLICATION.failure: Negotiations break down. They attack or demand too much (magic items, all your food).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2 specific. Morlocks worship Belcorra as 'Ghost Queen'. They might want: rations, gold, shiny trinkets, or promise to leave offerings. Successful negotiation can reveal King Graulgust's location or warn about traps. If combat starts: 1d3+1 Morlocks (Level 2, HP 38, AC 17).

COMPLICATION.title: Giant Maggot Blocks Passage
COMPLICATION.description: One of Boss Skrawng's 'war maggots' (actually just a giant maggot) blocks the passage. It's not aggressive, just... there. Slowly munching on debris.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Nature to calm it OR DC 18 Athletics to push it aside
COMPLICATION.success: It moves aside peacefully or you shove it. It's surprisingly docile.
COMPLICATION.failure: It thrashes and alerts nearby mitflits. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific. Boss Skrawng's 'army' is pathetic. Maggot isn't hostile, just in the way. Mitflits think it's terrifying.

COMPLICATION.title: Territorial Mitflit Guards Nest
COMPLICATION.description: A group of mitflits (tiny blue gremlins) block the passage, chittering angrily. Behind them you see a crude nest with shiny objects. They worship a rusty helmet as their 'Sky King'.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Intimidation to scare them off OR DC 17 Diplomacy to offer shinier treasure
COMPLICATION.success: They flee or accept your offering and let you pass. If Diplomacy, they tell you about 'big snoring thing in tower'.
COMPLICATION.failure: They screech and attack with shortbows and makeshift weapons. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific - mitflit infestation. If intimidated, they return with Boss Skrawng later. If diplomacy, they provide info about sleeping threats.

COMPLICATION.title: Morlock Sentry Guards Ghost Queen's Domain
COMPLICATION.description: A morlock warrior stands guard, clutching a crude spear. He growls: 'Ghost Queen's territory! You leave now or join the eaten ones!' His eyes reflect light like an animal's.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Intimidation to make them back down OR DC 19 Deception to claim you 'serve the Ghost Queen'
COMPLICATION.success: They step aside warily. If Deception, they warn you 'ghouls on Floor 3 eat everyone, even us'.
COMPLICATION.failure: They howl to alert others and attack. Roll initiative. Reinforcements arrive in 1d4 rounds.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2 specific - morlock guards. 'Ghost Queen' is Belcorra. If intimidated, they remember you and are hostile later.

COMPLICATION.title: Ghoul Librarian Protects Sacred Texts
COMPLICATION.description: A ghoul in tattered robes blocks the passage to a library section. She hisses: 'These texts belong to the Cult of the Canker! Turn back, or become cankerous flesh for our Queen's vessel!'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Intimidation to intimidate OR DC 19 Religion to invoke Nhimbaloth's name
COMPLICATION.success: She reluctantly steps aside. If Religion used, she mutters 'The Empty Death watches all' and provides cryptic warning about 'the flesh golem in the temple'.
COMPLICATION.failure: She shrieks and attacks with paralytic claws. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3 specific - Cult of the Canker ghoul. Religion check shows knowledge of Nhimbaloth worship. Warns about flesh golem in Temple of Canker (C34).

COMPLICATION.title: Mitflit Alarm System
COMPLICATION.description: Crude bells and cans strung across the passage. One wrong move triggers a cacophony.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Thievery to disarm, DC 16 Acrobatics to navigate without touching
COMPLICATION.success: Pass safely or disarm system. Gain +2 to detect similar traps.
COMPLICATION.failure: Trigger alarm: loud noise alerts all mitflits on floor. They swarm your location.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflit alarms are crude but effective. Swarm is 2d4 mitflits.

COMPLICATION.title: Unstable Floor Collapse
COMPLICATION.description: The floor here is weakened from mitflit tunneling. Cracks spider across the stone.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Perception to notice, DC 17 Athletics to cross safely
COMPLICATION.success: Cross safely or find alternate route. Mark hazard on map.
COMPLICATION.failure: Floor collapses: 3d6 falling damage, loud crash alerts nearby creatures, trapped in pit.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflit tunnels undermine structure. Pit is 20 feet deep.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Falling damage, trapped in a pit, noise

COMPLICATION.title: Mitflit Graffiti Maze
COMPLICATION.description: Walls covered in confusing mitflit graffiti. Arrows point in all directions, some deliberately misleading.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Survival to navigate, DC 17 Society to understand mitflit symbols
COMPLICATION.success: Navigate correctly or decode symbols revealing safe paths.
COMPLICATION.failure: Get lost: waste 30 minutes (add 3 dice to jar), or walk into mitflit ambush.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflits deliberately confuse intruders. Ambush is 1d4+1 mitflits.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Lost time or a mitflit ambush

COMPLICATION.title: Morlock Darkness Trap
COMPLICATION.description: Morlocks have extinguished all light sources. Pitch black ahead, sounds of movement.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Perception to navigate by sound, DC 16 Survival to find way without light
COMPLICATION.success: Navigate safely. If you have darkvision, automatic success.
COMPLICATION.failure: Stumble into morlock ambush. They have advantage (you're flat-footed).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Morlocks have light blindness but superior darkvision. Ambush is 1d4 morlocks.

COMPLICATION.title: Fungal Spore Cloud
COMPLICATION.description: Disturbed fungus releases thick spore clouds. Air becomes hazy and difficult to breathe.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Fortitude save to resist, DC 18 Nature to identify safe path
COMPLICATION.success: Resist spores or find path around. No ill effects.
COMPLICATION.failure: Sickened 2 from spores, -2 to all checks for 1 hour. Coughing alerts morlocks.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Morlock fungus gardens are hazardous. Sickened condition is serious.

COMPLICATION.title: Morlock Tunnel Network
COMPLICATION.description: Narrow morlock tunnels branch off in multiple directions. Some are dead ends, others loop back.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Survival to track correct path, DC 18 Perception to spot morlock signs
COMPLICATION.success: Find correct path or discover morlock patrol schedule.
COMPLICATION.failure: Get lost in tunnels: waste 1 hour (add 6 dice to jar), or encounter morlock patrol.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Morlock tunnels are confusing. Patrol is 1d4+1 morlocks.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Lost time or a morlock patrol

COMPLICATION.title: Unstable Bookshelf Towers
COMPLICATION.description: Ghouls have stacked books precariously high. Shelves sway and creak ominously.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Acrobatics to navigate safely, DC 17 Athletics to stabilize if they start falling
COMPLICATION.success: Pass safely or catch falling books before loud crash.
COMPLICATION.failure: Shelves collapse: 2d6 bludgeoning damage, loud crash alerts all ghouls on floor.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. Ghouls are hoarders, not organizers. Collapse alerts 2d4 ghouls.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Damage and a floor-wide ghoul alert

COMPLICATION.title: Cursed Tome Trap
COMPLICATION.description: A beautiful tome sits open on a pedestal. Text glows invitingly, begging to be read.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Arcana to detect curse, DC 19 Will save to resist compulsion to read
COMPLICATION.success: Detect curse and avoid, or resist compulsion. Can safely close book.
COMPLICATION.failure: Read cursed text: confused for 1d4 rounds, or cursed (-1 to all mental checks for 24 hours).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. Ghouls use cursed books as traps. Confusion in combat is dangerous.

COMPLICATION.title: Library Silence Ward
COMPLICATION.description: Magical ward enforces absolute silence. Speaking or loud noise triggers painful feedback.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Arcana to detect ward, DC 18 Stealth to move silently through area
COMPLICATION.success: Detect ward and communicate via gestures, or move silently.
COMPLICATION.failure: Make noise: 2d6 sonic damage to all party members, alerts ghouls, can't cast verbal spells.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. Ghouls protect their library. No verbal spells while in ward area.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Sonic damage, no verbal spells, ghouls alerted

COMPLICATION.title: Leech-Infested Waters
COMPLICATION.description: Passage is flooded ankle-deep. Water writhes with thousands of leeches.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Fortitude save vs leech swarm, DC 18 Athletics to wade through quickly
COMPLICATION.success: Resist leeches or cross before they attach. No damage.
COMPLICATION.failure: Leeches attach: 1d6 bleed damage per round, drained 1. Requires DC 15 Medicine to remove.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. Volluk's leeches are everywhere. Drained condition stacks.

COMPLICATION.title: Belcorra's Magical Wards
COMPLICATION.description: Shimmering magical wards crisscross the passage. Touching them triggers alarms.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 19 Arcana to identify ward type, DC 18 Acrobatics to navigate through
COMPLICATION.success: Identify wards and find safe path, or navigate without triggering.
COMPLICATION.failure: Trigger ward: magical alarm alerts Belcorra's servants, or 3d6 force damage.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. Belcorra's personal wards are powerful. Alarm brings 1d4+1 servants.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Force damage or Belcorra's servants alerted

COMPLICATION.title: Alchemical Spill Hazard
COMPLICATION.description: Broken vats leak alchemical compounds. Floor is slick with corrosive, smoking liquid.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Crafting to identify safe path, DC 18 Acrobatics to cross without slipping
COMPLICATION.success: Identify safe compounds or cross safely. Can harvest reagents (50gp worth).
COMPLICATION.failure: Slip and fall: 2d6 acid damage, sickened 1 from fumes, or trigger chain reaction (3d6 to all).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Seugathi experiments are dangerous. Chain reaction alerts all creatures on floor.

COMPLICATION.title: Containment Breach Warning
COMPLICATION.description: Flashing runes warn of containment breach. Something dangerous is loose in this area.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Arcana to understand warning, DC 19 Perception to locate escaped experiment
COMPLICATION.success: Understand threat level and location. Can prepare or avoid.
COMPLICATION.failure: Stumble into escaped fleshwarp: surprise round against you, or don't know what you're facing.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Escaped experiment is level-appropriate fleshwarp. It's confused and aggressive.

COMPLICATION.title: Binding Circle Failure
COMPLICATION.description: A devil's binding circle is cracked and failing. The devil inside is almost free.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 20 Arcana to repair binding, DC 19 Diplomacy to negotiate with devil
COMPLICATION.success: Repair binding (devil owes you favor), or negotiate deal (devil helps once then leaves).
COMPLICATION.failure: Binding breaks: devil is free and hostile, or devil tricks you into bad contract.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Devil is level-appropriate. Favor or deal can be useful. Bad contract has consequences.
COMPLICATION.consequence: A free, hostile devil or a bad contract

COMPLICATION.title: Hellfire Vents
COMPLICATION.description: Cracks in floor vent hellfire periodically. Pattern seems random but might be predictable.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Perception to identify pattern, DC 18 Acrobatics to time crossing
COMPLICATION.success: Identify pattern and cross safely. Mark safe times on map.
COMPLICATION.failure: Caught in hellfire: 3d6 fire damage, or knocked prone and must try again.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Hellfire vents every 1d4 rounds. Pattern repeats once identified.

COMPLICATION.title: Infernal Contract Trap
COMPLICATION.description: A contract lies on the floor. Reading it binds you to its terms unless you understand the loophole.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 21 Society to read Infernal, DC 20 Diplomacy to find loophole
COMPLICATION.success: Understand contract and avoid, or find loophole (gain benefit without obligation).
COMPLICATION.failure: Bound by contract: must complete task for devil, or suffer -2 to all rolls until fulfilled.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Infernal contracts are binding. Task is difficult but not impossible. Loophole gives +1 item.

COMPLICATION.title: Bog Water Flooding
COMPLICATION.description: Passage is flooded with stagnant bog water. Smells of decay and death.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Fortitude save vs disease, DC 18 Athletics to wade through
COMPLICATION.success: Resist disease or find shallow path. Cross safely.
COMPLICATION.failure: Contract bog rot: sickened 2, -2 to Fortitude saves for 24 hours, or stuck in mud (restrained).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. Bog rot is serious disease. Requires Medicine DC 18 to treat.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Bog rot or stuck in mud

COMPLICATION.title: Mummy Rot Contamination
COMPLICATION.description: Area is contaminated with mummy rot. Dust and spores fill the air.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Fortitude save to resist, DC 17 Medicine to identify and treat
COMPLICATION.success: Resist contamination or treat immediately. No infection.
COMPLICATION.failure: Infected with mummy rot: can't heal naturally, -1 to all physical checks, spreads to others.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. Mummy rot is curse-disease. Requires remove curse or similar magic to cure fully.

COMPLICATION.title: Faction Patrol Route
COMPLICATION.description: You're in the middle of a faction patrol route. Voices approach from both directions.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Survival to find alternate route quickly
COMPLICATION.success: Hide successfully or find escape route. Patrols pass without noticing.
COMPLICATION.failure: Spotted by patrol: must fight or flee, or caught between two patrols (surrounded).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. Each patrol is 1d4+1 faction members. Being surrounded is very dangerous.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Spotted or surrounded by a patrol

COMPLICATION.title: Darklands Spider Webs
COMPLICATION.description: Massive spider webs block the passage. They're sticky and strong.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 17 Athletics to break through, DC 18 Survival to find path around
COMPLICATION.success: Break through or find alternate route. No encounter.
COMPLICATION.failure: Stuck in webs (restrained), or vibrations alert giant spiders (1d4 spiders attack).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. Giant spiders are level-appropriate. Restrained condition is serious in combat.

COMPLICATION.title: Faction War Aftermath
COMPLICATION.description: Recent battle between factions. Bodies, blood, and the wounded remain.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Medicine to help wounded, DC 17 Diplomacy to gain faction favor
COMPLICATION.success: Help wounded and gain faction favor (+2 to Diplomacy with that faction), or loot bodies (50gp).
COMPLICATION.failure: Wounded die or you're seen looting - faction becomes hostile.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. Roll faction: 1-2 drow, 3-4 urdefhan, 5-6 caligni. Favor is valuable.

COMPLICATION.title: Reality Tear Hazard
COMPLICATION.description: Reality is thin here. A tear in space-time warps the area. Nhimbaloth's influence bleeds through.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 21 Occultism to understand tear, DC 20 Will save to resist mental influence
COMPLICATION.success: Understand tear and navigate safely, or resist Nhimbaloth's whispers.
COMPLICATION.failure: Reality warps: teleported to random location on floor, or confused for 1d4 rounds.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. Reality tears are extremely dangerous. Random teleport can separate party.

COMPLICATION.title: Void Energy Corruption
COMPLICATION.description: Void energy saturates this area. Everything feels wrong, empty, hollow.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 20 Fortitude save vs corruption, DC 21 Arcana to shield yourself
COMPLICATION.success: Resist corruption or create protective ward. Pass safely.
COMPLICATION.failure: Corrupted by void: doomed 1, -2 to all saves vs void effects, or 3d6 negative damage.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. Void corruption is cumulative. Doomed condition is very serious.

COMPLICATION.title: Undercut Plank Walkway
COMPLICATION.description: A plank walkway crosses a stretch of shallow swamp between two ruined walls. The supports underneath have fresh saw marks - and you can hear muffled giggling somewhere nearby.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 15 Perception to spot the sabotage. Crossing safely means one Medium creature at a time (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR), or a DC 15 Reflex save to catch the edge if it collapses.
COMPLICATION.success: You cross one at a time and the planks hold. You also find the mitflits' abandoned saw tucked under the near end.
COMPLICATION.failure: The walkway collapses with a groaning crash, dumping everyone on it into 4 feet of water over sucking mud (greater difficult terrain). DC 15 Athletics to climb out.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. The Mud Lickers sabotage crossings (as at the A2 drawbridge). A collapse wakes a Slurk if one is near: roll a DC 11 flat check; on a success it arrives in 2 rounds. Small creatures cross without triggering the collapse.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Noise, a soaking, possibly a slurk
COMPLICATION.reward: A mitflit saw (counts as a short tool)

key_abilities: Spits slime at prey crossing water
Never leaves sight of its pond

COMPLICATION.title: Fogbank from the Fogfen
COMPLICATION.description: A wall of white fog rolls through the broken walls, swallowing the ruins. Within a minute you can't see the hero next to you. Somewhere above, a faint blue light pulses on and off.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 15 Survival (group check) to keep together, or DC 15 Perception for one hero to fix on the lighthouse's glow and use it as a landmark.
COMPLICATION.success: You navigate by the lighthouse and move with confidence. Gain 1 Prepared token.
COMPLICATION.failure: The party scatters. Regrouping costs time, and the first hero to fail is alone for the first round of the next encounter.
COMPLICATION.time_cost: 10 minutes to regroup on failure (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR)
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. Only sunlight filtered through the constant Fogfen mist lights the ruins. The Gauntlight glows a faint eerie blue at night - Wrin Sivinxi is the only one in Otari who can see it from town. Prepared token: next time the party would add dice to the jar, add 1 fewer (minimum 0).
COMPLICATION.reward: 1 Prepared token on success

COMPLICATION.title: 'Try the Magic Pixie Mud!'
COMPLICATION.description: A high, sing-song voice floats down from somewhere above the cobwebs: 'Welcome, welcome, big friends! Mind the mean bugs! But oooh, try the magic pixie mud on the floor - it makes you lucky!' Then a snort of suppressed giggling.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 10 Perception to see through it - the Mud Lickers are terrible liars. Spotting where they're hiding takes DC 12 Perception.
COMPLICATION.success: You don't step in the dung, and you spot two mitflits in the rafters. Grab one (DC 15 Athletics) and it squeals everything it knows to save itself.
COMPLICATION.failure: You step squarely into a pile of mitflit dung: DC 15 Fortitude save or sickened 1 for 10 minutes. The mitflits collapse in giggles, then flee to warn their boss.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflits have -1 Deception and speak only Undercommon. A captured one reveals: Boss Skrawng lives in the old barracks (A10), he's afraid of the 'big ghost' in the lighthouse, and 'mushroom-eyed people' (morlocks) chased the Mud Lickers out of the level below. If they escape, Skrawng is waiting at attention with his pet solifugid when the party arrives.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Sickened, and Boss Skrawng is warned
COMPLICATION.reward: Intel on Boss Skrawng from a captured mitflit

key_abilities: Shrieks and casts bane when hurt

COMPLICATION.title: A Green Light Inside the Ribs
COMPLICATION.description: A skeleton in moldy acolyte's robes lies in a corner. As you pass, a sickly green glow kindles inside its ribcage and its finger bones twitch.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 15 Religion to recognize a corpselight trying to take hold of a host. Smash the skeleton before it rises: DC 15 Athletics, or any attack against AC 10.
COMPLICATION.success: You scatter the bones before the corpselight can animate them. Among them is a gold tooth (4 gp).
COMPLICATION.failure: The skeleton lurches up, green light blazing in its chest. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 1. Corpselights haunted the Nhimbaloth shrine (A15) and seek new bodies when forced out of old ones. If combat starts and the corpselight is driven into wisp form, it tries to claim any other corpse within reach - including a fallen hero.
COMPLICATION.reward: Gold tooth (4 gp)

key_abilities: Jumps to a new corpse when its host is destroyed

COMPLICATION.title: Swollen Door
COMPLICATION.description: The door ahead is swollen with damp so badly that its frame has bowed. Behind it you hear water dripping - and something shuffling.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Athletics to wrench it open quietly. Heroes not trained in Athletics need two attempts.
COMPLICATION.success: It opens with a soft scrape onto a forgotten linen closet. A cedar chest inside holds servants' livery, still wearable.
COMPLICATION.failure: The door bursts open with a crack that echoes down the hall. 1d2 Morlocks arrive in 2 rounds to investigate.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Canon: every door on this level is swollen shut; a hero trained in Athletics opens one with a single Interact, others need two. The livery (Clothing (Fine)) makes undead servants treat the wearer as staff - +2 circumstance to Deception or Diplomacy against them.
COMPLICATION.reward: Servants' livery (Clothing (Fine)): +2 circumstance vs. undead servants

COMPLICATION.title: You're Tracking Mud on His Floor!
COMPLICATION.description: A chubby, cat-sized fly with a devil's face buzzes around the corner, a rag clutched in one claw - and stops dead at the sight of your muddy boot prints. 'No! NO! I JUST did this hall!' His eyes narrow. 'Surface people. I'm allowed to kill surface people.'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Diplomacy or Deception to convince him you're staff or that you'll clean up. Or help him clean: ADD 1 DIE TO JAR (10 minutes) and he's mollified automatically.
COMPLICATION.success: Zolazarin calms down. Grateful for anyone who sympathizes with his miserable contract, he offers to show you his most recent memory of surface people through his infernal eye.
COMPLICATION.failure: He attacks. His contract lets him defend the dungeon against aboveground intruders.
COMPLICATION.time_cost: 1 minute, or 10 minutes if you help clean
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Zolazarin is Belcorra's janitor, kept on the Material Plane far longer than his bargain required. His memory shows Otari Ilvashi fleeing through the dungeon to hide in B28; a DC 16 Society check recognizes the famous adventurer. If reduced to 10 HP or fewer in combat, he begs for his life and offers the same memory.
COMPLICATION.reward: Zolazarin's memory of Otari Ilvashi's escape route

key_abilities: Infernal eye records and replays memories
Contract requires him to clean the halls

COMPLICATION.title: Brown Mold Among the Roots
COMPLICATION.description: Tangled roots hang down a damp wall here, furred with a soft brown growth. The air around them is noticeably colder.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 16 Nature to recognize brown mold before anyone brushes against it.
COMPLICATION.success: You give it a wide berth. You also realize nothing that lives here will follow you into it.
COMPLICATION.failure: A hero brushes the mold: it leaches the heat from their body. 2d6 cold damage (DC 16 basic Fortitude).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Brown mold also grows on the beach at B20. The river drake Fresnel Kes has learned to avoid it and won't follow prey into it - a party fleeing her can shelter beside a patch.
COMPLICATION.reward: Knowledge of a refuge from the river drake

COMPLICATION.title: Offerings for the King of the Ghost City
COMPLICATION.description: Sheets of web stretch across the corridor, and in them hang tiny spiders the size of coins, all staring at you. A crude web-sculpture of towers and domes has been woven across the ceiling. A chittering voice in Aklo echoes from somewhere ahead: 'Visitors to the Ghost City must bring offerings to the King!'
COMPLICATION.challenge: Leave an offering of at least 5 gp worth of shiny things, or tear through: DC 16 Athletics or Reflex to avoid getting stuck.
COMPLICATION.success: The dream spiders part the webs. The King of the Ghost City will remember that you paid tribute.
COMPLICATION.failure: You tear through, but get tangled (immobilized until you succeed at a DC 16 Athletics check to Escape), and the spiders skitter off to report.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 2. Mimnivix, a web lurker who fancies himself king of the illusory Absalom in Belcorra's war room (B30), expects visitors to be supplicants. If the party paid tribute, his first round in any later meeting is spent demanding more gifts instead of attacking. Dream spiders are his minions.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Immobilized, and the web lurker is warned
COMPLICATION.reward: Mimnivix spends his first round demanding gifts instead of attacking
COMPLICATION.creatures: Dream spiders (harmless unless Mimnivix commands them)

COMPLICATION.title: Blue Blisters in the Meat Cart
COMPLICATION.description: A handcart blocks a narrow aisle, piled with morlock limbs on their way to some ghoulish larder. The flesh is studded with swollen blue blisters, and the smell is overpowering.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Medicine or Nature to recognize the danger before you shove the cart aside.
COMPLICATION.success: You recognize blue blisters, a flesh-eating disease, and move the cart with a pole or cloth without touching the meat.
COMPLICATION.failure: You handle the meat. DC 18 Fortitude save or contract blue blisters.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. The cult's food storage (C21) is a meat locker of dead morlocks crawling with blue blisters; the ghouls find infected flesh savory. A cart in the stacks means ghouls are nearby: roll a DC 11 flat check, and on a success 1d2 Ghouls return for it in 3 rounds.

COMPLICATION.title: A Spark Among the Stacks
COMPLICATION.description: A loose page drifts down from a high shelf straight into your light - and catches. In this stuffy, paper-dry air the flame races up the page toward a shelf of crumbling folios.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Smother it in one round: DC 18 Athletics or Crafting, or use the sand from a fire bucket if anyone spotted the SAFETY sign earlier.
COMPLICATION.success: You beat it out. In the singed pile beneath, one folio didn't burn at all - it's waterproofed, and worth something.
COMPLICATION.failure: The shelf goes up. Everyone adjacent takes 2d6 fire damage (DC 18 basic Reflex), the smoke draws ghouls, and 1 Bulk of Morlibint's books is lost.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. Undercommon signs throughout the library point to a firefighting storeroom marked SAFETY with a carving of leaping flames (C17), which holds a wand of quench. The ghouls hate fire but come to investigate smoke: 1d3 Ghouls arrive in 2 rounds on a failure.
COMPLICATION.reward: An intact waterproofed folio (1 Bulk for Morlibint)

COMPLICATION.title: Gibbering Up the Pipes
COMPLICATION.description: From a drain in the floor comes a sound like a dozen people babbling at once - wet, overlapping, insane. It rises in pitch as if whatever is making it has noticed you.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Will save to keep your head. DC 18 Occultism to identify the sound.
COMPLICATION.success: You hold it together and recognize a gibbering mouther in the cavern below. It attacks anything that moves - including ghouls.
COMPLICATION.failure: Confused for 1 round as the babbling floods your mind.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. A gibbering mouther has lived in the pool cavern (C40) for decades, crawling to the C2 tunnel to hunt bats and rats. It doesn't distinguish the party from other denizens. A party that knows it's there can lure it into a fight with ghouls or morlocks; in the next Floor 3 fight against ghouls, the party may have the mouther arrive in round 3 and attack the ghouls first.
COMPLICATION.reward: Option to lure the gibbering mouther into a fight with ghouls

COMPLICATION.title: 'Are You Here to Donate?'
COMPLICATION.description: A ghoul in a long pale blue robe steps out of the stacks with an armful of books, sees you, and licks its lips slowly. 'Visitors. Are you here,' it asks politely, 'to donate flesh for the canker?'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 18 Deception to play along ('Later - we're expected by the High Priestess'), or DC 18 Intimidation to make it back off. Or a hero can actually donate a finger, toe or ear.
COMPLICATION.success: The ghoul bows and lets you pass. If someone donated, it scurries off toward the temple with the offering and tells the others you're friends of the canker.
COMPLICATION.failure: Its patience snaps. It drops the books and attacks.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. Straight from the book (C11). A hero who donates takes 1d6 slashing damage and 1 persistent bleed, and loses a finger, toe or ear for good. For the rest of this delve, cult ghouls on Floor 3 treat the donor as a friend of the canker: +2 circumstance to Deception and Diplomacy against them.
COMPLICATION.reward: If someone donates: +2 circumstance to Deception and Diplomacy vs. cult ghouls for the delve

COMPLICATION.title: Scent Hunters in the Stacks
COMPLICATION.description: Two ghouls move along the far end of the aisle, heads low, nostrils flaring. They're tracking by smell, and they're getting closer.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Mask your scent: smear lamp-black and old ink dust from a dry inkwell over yourselves (DC 18 Crafting or Survival, ADD 1 DIE TO JAR). Or DC 18 Stealth (group check) to stay downwind.
COMPLICATION.success: They pass within ten feet. One mutters to the other: 'The golem's left arm rotted off again. Nhakazarin wants two more morlocks by tonight.'
COMPLICATION.failure: They catch your scent and turn toward you, grinning. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.time_cost: 10 minutes to mask scent (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR)
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 3. The cult is stuck in a loop: it collects 'cankerous flesh' for Belcorra's new body (C34) but keeps eating it. Overhearing this tells the party the flesh golem isn't finished and how the cult gets its flesh - useful before they face Nhakazarin or decide what to do with the statue.
COMPLICATION.reward: Avoid the patrol and overhear the state of the flesh golem

COMPLICATION.title: Footsteps That Keep Following
COMPLICATION.description: Behind you, at a steady pace, you hear the scrape of armored feet on stone. When you stop, it stops. When you move, it moves. It's been doing this for a while.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Lose them: DC 19 Stealth or Survival (group check), or set an ambush (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR).
COMPLICATION.success: You lose them in the fungus-choked side passages. Or, if you ambushed, you get the first round.
COMPLICATION.failure: They catch up at the worst moment: 2 Cairn Wights join the next encounter on Floor 4.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. Two cairn wights, Belcorra's traitorous apprentices, wait in the northernmost sarcophagi of the Ghostwalk (D12). Once they spot intruders they pursue relentlessly across the whole level. If the party ambushes them, they get a surprise round.
COMPLICATION.reward: Ambush the pursuers on your terms

COMPLICATION.title: The Spectral Dinner Service
COMPLICATION.description: The air goes cold and a table you didn't see a moment ago is laid with silver and candles. Translucent servants glide in and pull out chairs for you, bowing. One sets a goblet of dark wine at each place and waits, expectantly.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Play along without drinking: DC 19 Deception or Performance (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR, 10 minutes). Or refuse: DC 19 Diplomacy to excuse yourselves gracefully.
COMPLICATION.success: The servants are satisfied. As the vision fades, one bends close and whispers: 'The master's desk. The left leg. There is a key.'
COMPLICATION.failure: The spirits are offended. A spectral tray flies at one hero: 2d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 19 basic Reflex). Anyone who drank the wine must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or be sickened 2.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. A replay of Belcorra's poisoned feast (D1). The key is real: a DC 25 Perception check finds an iron key in a secret slot in a leg of Volluk's desk in the Lounge (D8). It opens Lasda's manacles in D9 - otherwise each of the four manacles needs three successes at DC 22 Thievery while the hero stands in the necromantic ribbon.
COMPLICATION.reward: The location of the key to Lasda's manacles

COMPLICATION.title: Corpse Light Looking for a Body
COMPLICATION.description: A green, flickering light drifts out of a wall like a will-o'-wisp, bobbing as if searching. It hovers over the corpse of something you killed earlier - and starts to sink into it.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Destroy or drag away nearby bodies before it settles: DC 19 Athletics (1 round), or DC 19 Religion to drive it off with a prayer.
COMPLICATION.success: It has nowhere to go. It drifts away down the hall, looking for something else dead.
COMPLICATION.failure: The corpse lurches upright with green light pouring from its eyes.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. Corpselights flee their hosts when forced into wisp form and go looking for another corpse (canon D1-D6). Any corpse the party leaves behind on this level is a potential host.
COMPLICATION.reward: Avoid a fight by denying it a host

key_abilities: Jumps to a new corpse when its host is destroyed

COMPLICATION.title: Despair Leaking from the Temple
COMPLICATION.description: A wave of hopelessness rolls down the corridor from somewhere ahead. Your steps slow. It feels as if every grave in the world is open and empty, and always will be.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 19 Will save.
COMPLICATION.success: You shake it off. You also sense where it's coming from: a temple nearby, its altar gripped by a seven-fingered hand.
COMPLICATION.failure: Frightened 1, and you can't reduce it for 10 minutes.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. The Upper Temple of Nhimbaloth (D13) forces a DC 22 Will save on entry and births a new flickerwisp every dusk. Both effects end only when the four Roseguard icons are placed on its altar - which also drops the spectral barrier blocking the way to Level 5. A hero who succeeded senses the despair is anchored to that altar.
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn where the despair comes from

COMPLICATION.title: Leeches from the Ceiling
COMPLICATION.description: Drip. Something cold and wet lands on the back of your neck. You look up: the ceiling is crawling with leeches, thousands of them, slowly dropping.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 19 Perception to notice before you're under them, or DC 19 Reflex to get clear.
COMPLICATION.success: You back away before they fall. If you have salt, a handful sends them shriveling and you pass freely.
COMPLICATION.failure: A brood leech swarm drops on the party. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 4. Volluk's leeches are everywhere - he fed himself to a vat of them to become a worm-that-walks. Leeches that escaped his body have bred in the damp. Salt from the kitchen (D2) shrivels them.

COMPLICATION.title: A Door That Swings Shut
COMPLICATION.description: You prop a heavy, gouged door open behind you to keep your retreat clear. A few moments later it swings slowly closed on its counterweight, latching with a boom that echoes down the hall.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Wedge it properly: DC 20 Crafting (1 minute), or hold it with a piton.
COMPLICATION.success: The door stays open. Your retreat path is clear.
COMPLICATION.failure: The boom carries. The next Floor 5 encounter knows you're coming, and the door has to be reopened under pressure if you retreat.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. Canon: the iron-banded doors on this level are weighted to swing closed a few moments after being opened, unless propped. Nearly all of them are gouged and scarred by beasts smashing through.
COMPLICATION.reward: A clear retreat path

COMPLICATION.title: Spores Drifting on the Air
COMPLICATION.description: Tiny white motes drift past in the lantern light, floating out from a doorway thick with fuzzy white fungus. A soft, sweet smell clings to everything they touch.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Nature to recognize the danger in time. Then cover all exposed skin with cloth and hurry through (1 minute), or DC 20 Fortitude for each hero who doesn't.
COMPLICATION.success: You wrap up and pass through in under a minute. No exposure.
COMPLICATION.failure: Each exposed hero who fails the Fortitude save contracts fungal rot (a level 6 disease).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. The waiting room (E15) is full of mounds of white fungus. Each minute a creature spends in the spores with exposed skin, it must save or contract fungal rot. Staying less than a minute is the safest approach.

COMPLICATION.title: The Door That Isn't a Door
COMPLICATION.description: The corridor ends in a door that sits slightly crooked in its frame, as if it fell in from the other side. As you reach for the handle, you hear a low murmur: '...the morlocks are stringy, the ghouls are sour, but the surface ones...'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 20 Perception to notice it's a mimic before you touch it. Or talk to it: DC 20 Diplomacy (mimics love to chat about flavors).
COMPLICATION.success: You don't touch it. If you talk to it, it trades gossip for a ration: it describes what's waiting in the next room by how it tastes.
COMPLICATION.failure: Your hand sticks fast to the door. DC 20 Athletics to Escape. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. Two mimics have recently arrived; one has wedged itself into a door frame in E13. A very stealthy approach lets the party overhear them murmuring about the flavors of the dungeon's denizens. In conversation, the mimic reveals the next encounter on this floor.
COMPLICATION.reward: The mimic reveals the next Floor 5 encounter for a ration

COMPLICATION.title: Gaze from the Concourse
COMPLICATION.description: The hall opens onto a balcony over a vaulted concourse glittering with strange stars. Below, among dozens of toppled, half-eaten statues, something large and many-legged turns its head toward you.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Avert your eyes and move on: DC 20 Stealth (group check). A hero who keeps their eyes shut takes a -2 circumstance penalty to the check but can't be targeted by a gaze.
COMPLICATION.success: You slip past unseen. On the way, you notice two statues below that look intact enough to restore.
COMPLICATION.failure: A basilisk meets a hero's eyes. DC 20 Fortitude save or slowed 1 for 1 minute (petrification starts on a critical failure). The pair begin climbing toward you.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. A mated pair of basilisks nests among their victims at the south end of the Grand Concourse (E10). Most statues are petrified fleshwarps. Two can be restored: an urdefhan, who gasps 'War Chieftain Khurfel! Belcorra has need of the eye!' and dies; and a mulventok, which attacks in a frenzy.
COMPLICATION.reward: Spot the two restorable statues

COMPLICATION.title: Something Wrong with Your Shadow
COMPLICATION.description: Your shadow on the wall moves a heartbeat after you do. Then it doesn't move at all, while you keep walking.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 20 Perception to notice before it's too late. DC 20 Religion or Occultism to understand.
COMPLICATION.success: You catch a shadow-thing slipping away into the dark. You recognize a greater shadow: it marks one victim at a time, steals their shadow and murders them. Bright light weakens it.
COMPLICATION.failure: The shadow has marked one hero for death. That hero takes a -2 circumstance penalty to Stealth for the rest of this delve: the assassin always knows where they are.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. Seora Phade, Belcorra's chief assassin, now a greater shadow, haunts the security checkpoint (E7) and focuses on one enemy at a time. She retreats when badly hurt to set up a later ambush and fights until destroyed. A hero who succeeds gets +1 circumstance to saves against her abilities.
COMPLICATION.reward: +1 circumstance to saves against Seora Phade

COMPLICATION.title: Heaps That Ooze Through Bars
COMPLICATION.description: Behind a row of rusted cell bars, three heaps of rotting meat and broken bone lie still. As you pass, one twitches. Then all three start to slide toward the gaps between the bars.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Get past before they reach you: DC 20 Acrobatics or Athletics to hurry through, or DC 20 Stealth to avoid waking them in the first place.
COMPLICATION.success: You're past before they finish oozing out. They lose interest and settle.
COMPLICATION.failure: They pour between the bars. Roll initiative against 2 Shanrigol Heaps.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. In the monster holding cells (E3), detritus has coalesced into near-mindless amalgams of undeath and twitching life. They ooze between bars without opening the doors. The center cell in E3 holds the copper key to the locked supply room (E11) - an occupant ate its bearer but couldn't digest the copper.

COMPLICATION.title: Acid Seeping Under the Door
COMPLICATION.description: Black, steaming sludge is seeping out from under a door, eating pits into the stone. Floating in it is a badge of black iron stamped with a pentagram - the only thing the sludge hasn't dissolved.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Hook the badge out without touching the sludge: DC 20 Thievery or Acrobatics.
COMPLICATION.success: You fish it out. It's the badge of a devil in service to Urevian, the contract devil who rules the level below the laboratories.
COMPLICATION.failure: Your boot slips into the sludge. 2d6 acid damage (DC 20 basic Reflex). If you made a lot of noise, whatever is on the other side of that door starts to stir.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 5. Several weeks ago Jafaki caught one of Urevian's devil spies, lured it into the sludge-filled room (E22), and fed it to an alchemically modified black pudding that dissolved it completely. The badge proves Urevian is spying on the seugathi; it's worth 20 gp and gives +2 circumstance to one Deception check against devils on Level 7.
COMPLICATION.reward: Infernal badge (20 gp; +2 circumstance to one Deception check vs. devils)

COMPLICATION.title: Acid-Pitted Floor
COMPLICATION.description: The floor here is honeycombed with acid pits, some still smoking. One section looks solid - but it's the same color as the stone around a hole that goes straight down.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Acrobatics to pick a safe path, or DC 22 Perception to spot the weakened section.
COMPLICATION.success: You cross safely. The acid has also eaten through the side of a sealed supply locker against the wall, and what's inside is intact.
COMPLICATION.failure: A section gives way under one hero: 2d6 acid damage (DC 22 basic Reflex), and one random piece of carried gear is damaged.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Acid pitting on floors and doors is a canon feature of the laboratories level. The supply locker holds 2 Acid Flasks (Moderate).
COMPLICATION.reward: 2 Acid Flasks (Moderate)

COMPLICATION.title: A Friendly Worm with a Net
COMPLICATION.description: A long, segmented creature undulates around the corner, waving a tentacle in what it clearly thinks is a friendly greeting. Your thoughts go soft and slow around the edges. 'Visitors! How delightful. Please - follow me, I'll show you somewhere comfortable.'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Will save against its mind fog aura, and DC 22 Perception to see through the act.
COMPLICATION.success: You see the capture net coiled in its other tentacles. It realizes it's been caught and flees, dropping a slate with your descriptions already written on it.
COMPLICATION.failure: Stupefied 1 for 1 minute, and you follow it a little way before noticing the net. It tries to capture the most stupefied hero; roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Canon: when warned, a seugathi suppresses its mind fog aura and feigns friendliness just long enough to put newcomers at ease, then tries to take them prisoner as research subjects - to the death if necessary. The dropped slate shows which heroes it judged toughest (the ones Jafaki would want).

COMPLICATION.title: An Invisible Buzzing
COMPLICATION.description: There's a faint droning in the air, like a fly trapped in a jar - but there's nothing there. The sound moves. It's following you.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Perception to pinpoint the invisible creature; then grab it (DC 22 Athletics) or bargain with it (DC 22 Diplomacy).
COMPLICATION.success: You catch an invisible zebub. Terrified of being reported for failing, it trades: the devils' foothold here is a barbazu and two zebubs, and they're preparing an incursion.
COMPLICATION.failure: It dimension-doors away to report you. The next devil encounter on Floor 6 or 7 is ready for you: they act first.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Canon: 1-in-3 chance a zebub is patrolling invisibly near the torture chamber (F24); if it spots the party undetected, it reports and the devils prepare. A devil below 15 HP flees back to the prison level and tells Urevian about the party.
COMPLICATION.reward: Intel on Urevian's foothold on this level

COMPLICATION.title: Something Stirs in the Pool
COMPLICATION.description: The corridor runs along a wall of cloudy transparent stone. Through it you see a dark underground pool - and floating in it, motionless, a cluster of reptilian heads. One of them twitches as your footsteps echo.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Stealth (group check) to pass without disturbing the water or making too much noise.
COMPLICATION.success: They stay asleep. You also count five square shafts in the cavern ceiling - a way down from the level above.
COMPLICATION.failure: One hydra begins to rouse. It's slowed 2 for 3d4 rounds while it wakes - time to get away, or to fight it before it's fully awake.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Jafaki keeps the hydras in a chemical stupor (F4). Each takes 3d4 rounds to wake and is slowed 2 meanwhile; every time one takes damage, reduce its remaining rounds by 3. They defend their territory to the death but don't pursue beyond the cave. The five shafts lead up to the Sentencing Chamber pits (E12).
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn the five shafts from the Sentencing Chamber drop into this pool

key_abilities: Chemical stupor: takes 3d4 rounds to wake, slowed 2 meanwhile

COMPLICATION.title: A Fleshwarp Under a Curse
COMPLICATION.description: A hulking fleshwarp stands guard at the top of a stair, twitching, shifting its weight, flinching at sounds that aren't there. Its eyes roll toward you. It's terrified - and it's going to kill you because of it.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Occultism or Religion to recognize an infernal malediction eating away at it.
COMPLICATION.success: You see the curse for what it is: slowly weakening it, feeding something else on its fear. It's at -2 to attack rolls and AC if you fight it, and it lets you pass if a seugathi seems to be with you.
COMPLICATION.failure: All you see is a jumpy monster. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. The fleshwarp guarding the stairs in Prisoner Processing (F10) is under the 'slow curse' - suggested by two will-o'-wisps on Level 7 (G12) so they can feed on its fear whenever they like. The seugathi don't realize it. It slaughters anyone not accompanied by a seugathi.
COMPLICATION.reward: The cursed guard is at -2 to attack rolls and AC

COMPLICATION.title: Stench from the Changing Stalls
COMPLICATION.description: A wall of rot hits you, so thick you can taste it. Somewhere ahead, claws scrape at the underside of wooden doors, and something giggles wetly.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 22 Fortitude save. DC 22 Religion or Medicine to identify the source.
COMPLICATION.success: You keep your stomach. You identify ghasts, locked in, starving - and realize whoever releases them will be the first thing they attack.
COMPLICATION.failure: Sickened 1 for 10 minutes.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 6. Jafaki's minions locked four ghasts in the spa's changing stalls (F21) with clockwork latches; one lever opens all four doors and then sticks. Freed ghasts attack any living creature they see - a cunning party can release them on enemies. Meran the skulk plans to do exactly that to the party.
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn how to turn the ghasts loose on enemies

COMPLICATION.title: Grothluts in Formation
COMPLICATION.description: The tramp of uneven feet echoes ahead. A column of grothluts shambles around the corner in a ragged line, moaning in rhythm, while a barbazu barks orders and raises a bracer that glows red whenever one stumbles out of step.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 23 Stealth (group check) to stay out of sight, or DC 23 Deception to pass yourselves off as Urevian's contractors.
COMPLICATION.success: They march past. You catch the command word the barbazu shouts to make the grothluts halt.
COMPLICATION.failure: The barbazu spots you and roars. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Urevian's devils have been training grothluts to fight against their seugathi creators (G3), using magical bracers to enforce obedience; the barbazu is immune to their moaning. In a later fight against this squad, a hero who shouts the command word makes all grothluts lose their next action.
COMPLICATION.reward: The grothluts' halt command

COMPLICATION.title: A Pocket of Severe Heat
COMPLICATION.description: The air ahead shimmers. Heat pours from cracks in the wall where magma runs somewhere close behind the stone, and the brimstone stench is suffocating.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 23 Fortitude save to push through, or DC 23 Survival to find a cooler route along the floor (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR).
COMPLICATION.success: You get through. Tucked in a niche where the lemure work crews rest, you find a stash of fire-suppression charms.
COMPLICATION.failure: 1d6 fire damage per round while crossing (3 rounds), and fatigued until you rest.
COMPLICATION.time_cost: 1 minute, or 10 minutes for the cooler route
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Belcorra's geomancers diverted a natural magma flow to power the summoning chamber (G7), where the air is magically cooled only to 'severe heat'.
COMPLICATION.reward: 2 Fulu of Fire Suppression

COMPLICATION.title: Wisps Feeding on Fear
COMPLICATION.description: Two pale lights drift lazily down the hall - then wink out. A moment later you feel your fear rising for no reason, and somewhere very close, something sighs with contentment.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 23 Will save, then DC 23 Perception to locate the invisible wisps.
COMPLICATION.success: You hold your nerve and spot them. They're used to feeding on terror, not facing courage; they flee to warn the barracks.
COMPLICATION.failure: Frightened 1, and the invisible wisps keep feeding on you. Roll initiative.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Two will-o'-wisps patrol the Arena Walk (G12), killing unfriendly creatures. The devils assumed they served Belcorra and the wisps simply agreed. They suggested the 'slow curse' on the fleshwarp in F10 so they could feed on its fear. If one is destroyed, the other flees to the barracks (G15) to warn the fleshwarps.

COMPLICATION.title: The Room Nobody Enters
COMPLICATION.description: A pair of fleshwarps comes down the corridor and swerves sharply around one particular doorway, giving it a wide berth. One makes a warding gesture. Chalked on the frame in Infernal: HAUNTED. STAY OUT.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Use their fear: DC 23 Stealth to hide near the doorway while they pass (but don't go in). Or DC 23 Religion or Occultism to work out whether it's really haunted.
COMPLICATION.success: You hide right beside it and they never look your way. If you investigated, you realize the rumor was planted - something in there wants privacy, and the room is trapped.
COMPLICATION.failure: They spot you and come at you.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 7. Ysondkhelir had Urevian's erinys start a rumor that the prison office (G16) is haunted, so the fleshwarps bunking nearby avoid it. In truth a hidden rune just past the threshold (a level 8 painful suggestion trap) guards a secret hallway to his rooms. Hiding here counts as 1 Prepared token.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Combat, or walking into a trap
COMPLICATION.reward: 1 Prepared token; warning about the trapped office

COMPLICATION.title: A Wisp over the Basin
COMPLICATION.description: A pale light hovers motionless over a basin of swamp water, looking like a decorative lamp. Then it turns - slowly - to follow you.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Act before it reports: DC 24 Perception to spot it first, then destroy it quickly, or DC 24 Stealth to slip out of its sight.
COMPLICATION.success: You stop it before it can report. Pour oil or resin into the basin afterward and that basin can never be used to watch again.
COMPLICATION.failure: It telepathically sends your image to its mistress. Belcorra Attacks! begins: she arrives through the Gauntlight's footprint and casts phantasmal calamity from a distance before retreating through the walls.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. Whenever any wisp in Chapters 8-9 sees the party, it alerts Belcorra and she resolves to harry them (30 XP each time they survive an attack). The nyth in H39 sealed its basins with fungal resin to make planters - which is how the party can blind them too.
COMPLICATION.reward: A permanently blinded basin

key_abilities: Reports to Belcorra through swamp basins

COMPLICATION.title: Whispers off the Water
COMPLICATION.description: As you pass a stream, the sound of the water changes. It isn't babbling any more - it's whispering, in many voices at once: 'Haruvex has risen. There is nothing you can do.'
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 24 Will save.
COMPLICATION.success: You hold onto yourself, and one clear phrase surfaces from the whispers: 'Three are within reach. One very close. One lost to Yldaris. One held by blood.'
COMPLICATION.failure: Stupefied 1 for 24 hours as the whispers settle into your mind.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. Echoes from the Island Cavern (H12), where Nhimbaloth's alien will whispers through the water. In the cavern itself, each minute requires a DC 24 Will save and the stupefied condition stacks up to 4, with a new 'truth' at each step - culminating in: 'Join the essences within Haruvex, and she can fall again.'
COMPLICATION.reward: A clue to the three fulcrum lenses

COMPLICATION.title: Water You Shouldn't Drink
COMPLICATION.description: The lake water looks clear enough here, and your waterskins are running low. Blind, spiny fish dart away from your reflection.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 24 Nature or Survival to judge whether it's safe.
COMPLICATION.success: It isn't - but you spot an old deep-gnome cistern nearby, sealed and clean, and refill there.
COMPLICATION.failure: Drinking exposes each hero to sewer haze (1-in-6 chance each). Eating the fish exposes everyone who eats them.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. The Fetid Lake (H15) was once potable and stocked with fish by the Children, but they let it fill with aberrations after Belcorra's fall. The fish are poisonous to most creatures and spread sewer haze even when cooked.
COMPLICATION.reward: A clean cistern for refilling water

COMPLICATION.title: Red Blooms Drifting Closer
COMPLICATION.description: Two enormous red flowers detach from the top of a fungus stalk and float toward you on no wind at all, swelling as they come.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 24 Nature to recognize them, then get out of their path: DC 24 Acrobatics, or lure them somewhere useful.
COMPLICATION.success: You recognize dragon blood puffballs - they burst in a deadly explosion when destroyed. You lead them toward your enemies instead, or simply outpace them.
COMPLICATION.failure: They reach you and burst: a fiery explosion that catches the party.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. Dragon blood puffballs grow in the overgrown eastern wilds (H34). They float toward prey, follow if it flees, and fight until destroyed in an explosive burst. A party that recognizes them can steer them into the next group of enemies on this floor.
COMPLICATION.reward: Steer the puffballs into the next enemies on this floor

COMPLICATION.title: A Skiff of Grumbling Mummies
COMPLICATION.description: Out of the mist glides a skiff with four small, mud-caked mummies at the oars, muttering to each other in Undercommon. 'Pillows. She wants more pillows.' 'The Mistress would never have chosen her.' They haven't seen you yet.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 24 Stealth (group check) to stay hidden, or join the grumbling: DC 24 Diplomacy to commiserate about their overseer.
COMPLICATION.success: If you hid, they glide past. If you talked, they're delighted someone understands, and tell you where the naga lounges and that a monster has wrecked the southern docks.
COMPLICATION.failure: They spot you and turn the skiff to attack.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. Lake random encounter (H15): four Children of Belcorra on a skiff. They resent their overseer Vthis (H23-H25) but stay loyal to Belcorra. The monster in the south is the frogemoth (H27), an Extreme encounter.
COMPLICATION.reward: Directions to Vthis's lair and a warning about the frogemoth

COMPLICATION.title: Bubbles near the Broken Dock
COMPLICATION.description: The water near a shattered dock bubbles, as if something enormous is breathing beneath it. A single stalked eye rises an inch above the surface, swivels toward you, and sinks again.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Get past quietly: DC 24 Stealth (group check), or take the long way around through the fungus (ADD 2 DICE TO JAR).
COMPLICATION.success: You get past. You also notice the creature's eye was clouded and its skin pocked with rot: it's sick.
COMPLICATION.failure: A massive tentacle whips out of the water at one hero. The creature fights for one round, then sinks back under.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 8. A bog-rotted frogemoth wrecked the outpost at H27 and drove everything out of the southern lake. It's an Extreme encounter for 8th-level characters. The Children's bog rot is weakening it more than they realize. In the lake random-encounter table it fights one round, then retreats; enraged at half HP, it follows attackers onto land.
COMPLICATION.consequence: One round with an Extreme threat
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn the frogemoth is weakened by bog rot

COMPLICATION.title: Fungus Thicker Than Walls
COMPLICATION.description: The path disappears into a forest of mushrooms so dense that stalagmites and crystal growths hide inside them. Two of you have already barked shins on something sharp.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 26 Survival to find the faint paths the drow use.
COMPLICATION.success: You find their trail and move through easily. You also spot a small cairn the drow built at a predator's kill site, marked with notes on what killed it.
COMPLICATION.failure: Greater difficult terrain the whole way (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR), and a pair of young riding lizards decides you're a threat.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. The Lizard Run (I30) is cultivated with a fast-growing fungus that hides drow movement. It's difficult terrain for the drow and their lizards, and greater difficult terrain for everyone else. The drow study kill sites to learn what hunts near home - the cairn notes warn of the gogiteth to the west.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Lost time and an angry pair of lizards
COMPLICATION.reward: The drow's trail, and their warning about the gogiteth

COMPLICATION.title: Gray-Black Fog on the Ground
COMPLICATION.description: The fungus thins to barren rock. A thick gray-black fog hugs the ground ahead, curling around your ankles. Something about it feels hungry.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 26 Survival or Religion to understand the fog before you go deeper.
COMPLICATION.success: You recognize a fiend's miasma and stay at its edge. Something large guards the far end - one of the two monsters blocking the caligni refugees' escape.
COMPLICATION.failure: You wander halfway in. The mist solidifies into tiny gnawing mouths: a level 10 hazard attacks the party.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. The Barrens (I31): the fog gives -2 to Perception, hides anything beyond 10 feet and blocks sight past 30 feet. When a non-fiend, non-urdefhan goes halfway in, the Demonic Fog hazard (level 10) triggers. A derghodaemon guards the south end; killing it dissolves the fog and opens one of Galudu's two blocked exits.
COMPLICATION.reward: Locate one of the caligni's blocked exits without triggering the fog

COMPLICATION.title: Drums of the Hunting Party
COMPLICATION.description: Deep drums boom through the caverns in a pattern, then stop. A moment later the pattern repeats, closer. Something is being hunted - and you have a feeling it's you.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 26 Society to read the drum code, or DC 26 Survival to read the hunters' tracks and get ahead of them.
COMPLICATION.success: You know their direction and numbers. You can avoid them entirely, or set an ambush and get a surprise round.
COMPLICATION.failure: They find you. The next encounter on Floor 9 is the war champion's hunting party, and they act first.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. If the party attacks the urdefhan war camp (I34) and retreats, Khurfel leads a lasher, a death scout and four warriors to hunt them. The Emerald Fulcrum Lens is strapped across his back at all times, and he never offers or accepts quarter.
COMPLICATION.consequence: The urdefhan war champion catches up
COMPLICATION.reward: Avoid or ambush Khurfel's hunting party
COMPLICATION.creatures: Khurfel, 1 Urdefhan Lasher, 1 Urdefhan Death Scout, 4 Urdefhan Warriors

COMPLICATION.title: Crystals That Sing
COMPLICATION.description: The shore here bristles with pale green crystals hanging from the ceiling and reaching toward the water in long strands. The path threads between them, barely wide enough.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 26 Acrobatics to pass without brushing any of them.
COMPLICATION.success: You slip through in silence. Broken shards on the ground are worth picking up.
COMPLICATION.failure: A crystal brushes your shoulder and begins to ring, setting off a chain reaction of loud, resonant chimes across the whole shore. Something answers from the lake.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. Touching a crystal on the Crystal Shore (I40) sets off ringing that draws the cathlaj nesting on the Island Nest (I41). The Ochre Fulcrum Lens lies in the water off the island's east shore, where Quara's father dropped it during his fight with Khurfel.
COMPLICATION.reward: Crystal shards (20 gp)

COMPLICATION.title: Bats Pouring Through the Dark
COMPLICATION.description: A rising chitter fills the cavern, and then the air is solid with tiny bats - hundreds, thousands - streaming past your heads in a single direction.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Keep your footing and concentration: DC 26 Fortitude or Will (spellcasters sustaining a spell must succeed to keep it going). Then DC 26 Perception to see where they're going.
COMPLICATION.success: They pour into a passage you hadn't noticed - one that slopes steeply down and out of the Hunting Grounds entirely.
COMPLICATION.failure: You're battered and disoriented for a few minutes (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR) and miss where they went.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. Hundreds of harmless bats lair in the Steep Exit (I42), which slopes 80 feet down to a 300-foot drop and disused passages - a way out of the Hunting Grounds that Galudu doesn't know about. She'll take her people that way if the party clears it.
COMPLICATION.reward: Discover the hidden exit Galudu's refugees need

COMPLICATION.title: A Dragon Watching for Lenses
COMPLICATION.description: A shadow passes overhead, too big to be a bat. Then the smell hits you - acid and swamp mud. Somewhere in the dark above, something enormous is sniffing at you.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 26 Stealth (group check) to slip away. Any hero carrying a fulcrum lens takes a -2 circumstance penalty.
COMPLICATION.success: It loses interest. You glimpse black scales, and realize it was sniffing for something specific - something you might be carrying.
COMPLICATION.failure: A black dragon drops into the path, eyes fixed on whoever carries a lens. 'Give me the colored glass. She promised it to me.'
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 9. Ravirex, a black dragon (I51), was told by Belcorra that she'd entrust a colored magical lens to him and now watches for lenses to win her favor. He targets lens-bearers. He's arrogant, and his den blocks one of Galudu's two exits. Ravirex is entry 12 on the random-encounter table.
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn what Ravirex wants - leverage in any negotiation with him

COMPLICATION.title: Doors That Won't Open
COMPLICATION.description: A stone door carved with a moss-filled skull and seven small divots bars the way. There's no handle, no latch and no keyhole. It doesn't budge.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Batter it down: hardness 15, 60 HP (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR). Or DC 27 Religion to understand who controls the doors.
COMPLICATION.success: You understand the doors answer to the Lady's Whisper; it opens them for those it chooses to test. Or you smash through.
COMPLICATION.failure: The noise of battering carries. Any dread wisps shadowing you report your position to Belcorra.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. Canon: the stone doors here are carved with a moss-filled skull, swirling mist or swamp scenes and clusters of seven divots, and the Lady's Whisper controls them. Metal tubes in the challenge chambers lead down to the swamp (J15) and are the other way through.
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn the doors obey the Lady's Whisper

COMPLICATION.title: A Light over the Basin
COMPLICATION.description: A wisp of cold light drifts in behind you at a polite distance and settles over a stone basin of reeds and swamp water, glowing softly. It isn't attacking. It's watching.
COMPLICATION.challenge: Destroy it before it reports: DC 27 Perception to act first, then defeat it. Or DC 27 Stealth to break its line of sight.
COMPLICATION.success: It dies or loses you before it can tell its mistress anything.
COMPLICATION.failure: It reports everything to Belcorra - including which of you carries fulcrum lenses. She'll target that hero first in the final battle.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. Two dread wisps may follow the party from the Initiates' Chamber (I64); at each challenge chamber one hovers over the basin and reports to Belcorra. In the Empty Vault she focuses on anyone carrying fulcrum lenses, especially the hero holding the lattice.
COMPLICATION.consequence: Belcorra knows who carries the lenses
COMPLICATION.reward: Belcorra doesn't learn who carries the lenses

key_abilities: Reports to Belcorra through swamp basins

COMPLICATION.title: It Whispers Your Names
COMPLICATION.description: A tall figure in a shroud stands where a moment ago there was nothing - a skeleton wrapped in grave cloth. It raises both hands in a gesture of peace and whispers each of your names in turn, softly, like a teacher calling the roll.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 27 Will save against the dread. DC 27 Perception (Sense Motive) to read it.
COMPLICATION.success: You stay calm, and you see past its gentleness: it resents you deeply, and it means to see you fail.
COMPLICATION.failure: Frightened 1 as your names hang in the air.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. The Lady's Whisper knows the party has come to face Belcorra and is ill-suited to join the (long-gone) cult, yet puts them through the initiation trials anyway, hoping to weaken and kill them. Each passed trial deepens its displeasure; it betrays them in the Maw of the Goddess (J18). A hero who read it can't be surprised by that betrayal.
COMPLICATION.reward: The party can't be caught flat-footed by the Lady's Whisper's betrayal

COMPLICATION.title: Fog in the Black Halls
COMPLICATION.description: Fog seeps up through the black stone floor until you're wading through it to the knee, then the waist. Carvings of bones and mist on the walls seem to shift in it.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 27 Survival (group check) to keep your bearings.
COMPLICATION.success: You keep a straight line and find a quiet side chamber where nothing has disturbed the dust in centuries - a safe place to rest.
COMPLICATION.failure: You lose your way and wander in circles (ADD 2 DICE TO JAR).
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. Canon: this lowest level is one of the safest. Its denizens generally stay put, and the heroes can rest as long as they need in its empty chambers. The Chamber of Reflection (J13) is a psychic refuge after the Challenge of Despair.
COMPLICATION.reward: An undisturbed chamber to rest in

COMPLICATION.title: Something Writhing in the Water
COMPLICATION.description: The water in the channel at your feet is full of tiny, pale, wriggling things - larvae, hundreds of them, swimming against the current toward the reeds.
COMPLICATION.challenge: DC 27 Nature or Occultism to identify them, then DC 27 Fortitude for anyone who wades through without protection.
COMPLICATION.success: You recognize the larvae of an isalo, an aberration that grows a new host body in the swamp whenever its old one dies. You find a way around.
COMPLICATION.failure: Larvae latch onto your legs. Sickened 1 until someone succeeds at a DC 27 Medicine check to remove them.
COMPLICATION.gm_notes: Floor 10. The isalo infestation in the Infested Reeds (J17) is malevolent but unaffiliated with Nhimbaloth. When its body is destroyed, its larvae scatter into the swamp to grow a new host. A party that identifies the larvae knows killing the host isn't the end of it.
COMPLICATION.reward: Learn the isalo regrows from its larvae

DILEMMA.title: Dying Mitflit Asks for 'Sky King Blessing'
DILEMMA.description: A dying mitflit gasps: 'Tell... Sky King... I was... brave...' They clutch a rusty nail like a holy symbol.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Show mercy: comfort them in their final moments. ADD 2 DICE TO JAR (20 minutes). With its last breath it presses its 'holy' rusty nail into your hand and whispers where it hid its treasure.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Move on: you have bigger concerns. NO DICE ADDED. They die alone, whimpering.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific. Emotional moment with a small payoff. The Mud Lickers are a dying gang - Skrawng's 'army' has been whittled down to a handful. Mitflits who later learn the party comforted one of their own are Friendly for a single parley.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off
DILEMMA.reward: The mitflit's hidden stash: 2d6 sp and a peridot bead (2 gp), wedged behind a loose stone nearby

DILEMMA.title: Wounded Morlock Begs for Mercy
DILEMMA.description: A morlock with ghoul bite marks begs for mercy in broken Common: 'Please... Ghost Queen's servants... they eat us... I just want to go home to the dark...'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Help them: bandage wounds and give rations. They tell you about ghoul patrols on Floor 3 and the 'flesh golem room'. ADD 1 DIE TO JAR (10 minutes)
DILEMMA.choice_b: Ignore them: resources preserved, but they crawl away whimpering. You miss information about Floor 3 dangers.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If helped, morlock warns about Cult of the Canker ghouls. Floor 2-3 specific. Morlocks worship Belcorra as 'Ghost Queen'.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Trapped Mitflit in Collapsed Tunnel
DILEMMA.description: A mitflit (tiny blue gremlin) is trapped under rubble, whimpering. His leg is pinned. Other mitflits fled, leaving him behind.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Save them: spend time digging them out. They tell you about Boss Skrawng's 'giant maggot army' plan. ADD 2 DICE TO JAR (20 minutes)
DILEMMA.choice_b: Leave them: they cry out 'Sky King abandons me!' You stay stealthy but hear their cries fade.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If saved, mitflit warns about Floor 1 boss plans. Floor 1 specific. Mitflits worship rusty helmet as 'Sky King'.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Wounded Mitflit Begging for Healing Potion
DILEMMA.description: A mitflit clutches a wound from a larger creature. They beg: 'Please! Healing water! I give you shiny!' They offer a handful of copper pieces.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Show compassion: give them a healing potion. Lose 1 potion. Grateful, they tell you Boss Skrawng sleeps in the old barracks, is terrified of the 'big ghost' in the lighthouse, and will sell a map to anyone who pays him 2 gold.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Stay focused: refuse. They whimper and crawl away. You preserve resources.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific. Canon: Skrawng (A10) becomes helpful for a bribe of at least 2 gp and something to write with, and trades crude maps of Level 1 and part of Level 2.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off
DILEMMA.reward: Boss Skrawng's location and his price (a 2 gp bribe makes him helpful)

DILEMMA.title: Wounded Morlock Warrior Seeks Honorable Death
DILEMMA.description: A morlock warrior, mortally wounded by ghouls, asks: 'Give... warrior death... not... eaten...' They offer their crude spear.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Show mercy: grant them an honorable death. Take their spear (+1 to next attack). Other morlocks may respect this. ADD 2 DICE TO JAR (20 minutes)
DILEMMA.choice_b: Move on: they'll die soon anyway. You preserve time.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Floor 2 specific. If mercy granted, morlocks may be less hostile later. Spear is masterwork quality.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Wounded Caligni Refugee
DILEMMA.description: A caligni (shadow person) clutches a bleeding wound. They speak in Sakvroth: 'The gug... Urthagul... he demands worship... I just wanted to reach the lodge...'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Help them: use healing magic or supplies. They warn you about the Cult of Urthagul on Floor 8 and mention Galudu's safe lodge. ADD 1 DIE TO JAR (10 minutes)
DILEMMA.choice_b: Ignore them: they fade into shadows, muttering about 'the Forsaken abandoning us'. You miss information about Floor 8-9 factions.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If helped, caligni explains the split between Dulac's cult (Floor 8) and Galudu's refugees (Floor 9). Floor 8-9 specific.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Ghoul Scribe Trapped in Ritual Circle
DILEMMA.description: A ghoul scribe from the Cult of the Canker is trapped in a warding circle, hissing. 'Free me! I must return to the scriptorium! The flesh golem needs more cankerous flesh!'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Free them: break the circle. They flee but drop a library key and mutter about 'Nhakazarin's temple'. Alert nearby ghouls.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Leave them: they rage and curse you. You stay stealthy and avoid alerting others.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If freed, provides key and hints about Floor 3 boss Nhakazarin. Floor 3 specific. Alerts 1d3 ghouls in 2 rounds.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Starving Morlock Child Lost from Pack
DILEMMA.description: A young morlock child, separated from their pack, huddles in a corner. They're terrified and starving, eyes reflecting light like an animal's.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Show compassion: give them rations and point toward Floor 2. They whisper 'Ghost Queen scary... ghouls eat us...' Lose 1 day rations.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Stay focused: ignore them. They cry softly. You preserve resources but feel their eyes watching.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If helped, provides context about morlock fear of ghouls. Floor 2-3 specific. Child may appear later as ally.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Fleshwarped Prisoner Begs for Death
DILEMMA.description: A grotesque fleshwarped humanoid (failed seugathi experiment) begs in garbled speech: 'Kill... me... please... can't... remember... my name...'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Mercy kill them: grant peaceful death. They whisper 'Jafaki's lab... Floor 6... stop him...' before dying. NO DICE ADDED
DILEMMA.choice_b: Leave them: they sob and claw at their own twisted flesh. You preserve resources but carry the moral weight.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If mercy killed, provides hint about Jafaki (Floor 6 boss). Floor 5-6 specific - seugathi fleshwarping victim.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Seugathi Experiment Gone Wrong
DILEMMA.description: A seugathi researcher is trapped in their own fleshwarping vat, tentacles dissolving. They telepathically plead: 'Help! The formula was wrong! I'll tell you about Jafaki's weakness!'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Save them: pull them out. They gasp out what they know - Jafaki never leaves the main laboratory, always sends the drider to answer a knock, and carries both plinth keys - but their telepathic screams alert nearby seugathi.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Leave them: they dissolve, screaming telepathically. You preserve stealth but carry the horror.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Floor 6 specific. Canon: Jafaki won't venture out in response to intruders and sends the drider to answer any knock (F25) - the party can exploit that to surprise them. Jafaki carries a round key and a four-prong key for the plinth room (F7); copies are in E5/F10 and F6/F16. Saving the seugathi alerts 1d2 seugathi in 3 rounds.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off
DILEMMA.reward: Jafaki's habits: the knock-and-drider weakness and where both plinth keys are

DILEMMA.title: Augrael the Ghoulish Morlock Seeks Books
DILEMMA.description: Augrael, a morlock infected with ghoul fever, sits reading peacefully. He's tranquil, rejected by both groups. 'I just want to read... and eat undead flesh. Do you have books?'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Show compassion: give him a book or scroll. He's deeply grateful and shares library layout knowledge. Lose 1 book/scroll.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Stay focused: refuse. He sighs sadly and returns to reading. You miss valuable Floor 3 intel.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Augrael is unique NPC from Floor 3 - biracial metaphor (morlock/ghoul). If helped, provides detailed library map.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off

DILEMMA.title: Wounded Drow Scout
DILEMMA.description: A drow hunter from Yldaris settlement clutches an arrow wound. She speaks in Elven: 'Urdefhan... war champion Khurfel... has the green lens... please, I need to warn Quara...'
DILEMMA.choice_a: Help them: bandage wound and escort to safety. She tells you about Khurfel's war camp and the Emerald Fulcrum Lens. ADD 2 DICE TO JAR (20 minutes)
DILEMMA.choice_b: Ignore them: she tries to crawl toward Yldaris settlement. You miss crucial information about Floor 9 boss and fulcrum lens.
DILEMMA.gm_notes: If helped, drow provides intel on Khurfel (Floor 9 boss) and Emerald Lens location. Floor 9 specific. May improve Quara's disposition.
DILEMMA.consequence: Moral vs tactical trade-off
