In the Maw of the Goddess (J18) it says: 'I know that you are pretenders. Defilers. You should not be here,' and attacks, using unwilling teleportation to send heroes back to J14.
DILEMMA.choice_c: Play along, but prepare. DC 27 Deception to seem compliant. ADD 1 DIE TO JAR. When it finally betrays you, the party gets +2 circumstance to initiative.

DILEMMA.title: The Lens Wants to Be Used
DILEMMA.description: The fulcrum lens in your pack has been humming since you entered this level. Now it's warm, and when you hold it you can feel exactly what it could do - right now - to the obstacle in front of you. Far away, something enormous turns its attention toward the hum.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Use its power. NO DICE ADDED. The obstacle in front of you falls (GM's choice of effect), but Nhimbaloth's gaze brushes the user: doomed 1 until their next daily preparations.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Wrap it in lead or layers of cloth to muffle it. ADD 1 DIE TO JAR. It stops humming, and Belcorra's wisps can no longer sense which of you carries it.
DILEMMA.consequence: Power now vs. safety from the Empty Death
DILEMMA.reward: Bypass one obstacle, or hide the lens-bearer from Belcorra's wisps
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Floor 10. Only for parties carrying at least one fulcrum lens. Belcorra's journals (I58) and The Whispering Reeds both warn that each lens holds a sliver of Nhimbaloth's essence, and that using their powers draws her scrutiny. Belcorra targets lens-bearers in the final battle.
DILEMMA.choice_c: Ignore it. NO DICE ADDED.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Patrol with 'War Maggots'
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You hear chittering and the squelch of giant maggots. A mitflit patrol approaches, riding their 'fearsome war beasts' (actually just slow maggots). You have seconds to act!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Stealth to hide OR DC 16 Deception to pretend you're 'inspecting for Sky King'
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by or believe your lie. One mitflit salutes the 'Sky King inspector'.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'Intruders! Alert Boss Skrawng!' Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific. 1d4+1 mitflits on giant maggots. Pathetic but numerous. Sky King is rusty helmet they worship.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Floor Collapsing!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The floor beneath you cracks and gives way! Everyone make a Reflex save!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Reflex save to grab edge. DC 19 Athletics to pull yourself up.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch yourself and climb up. No damage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You fall 15 feet into the room below. 3d6 damage. Separated from party.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: If anyone falls: they're in different room. Party must reunite. Adds tension.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Alarm Bell Ringing!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A loud bell starts ringing throughout this floor. You triggered a magical alarm!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Arcana or Thievery to disable in 3 actions, or flee immediately
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Alarm stops. Only nearby enemies alerted.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Alarm continues. All enemies on this floor are alerted and searching for you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: If alarm continues: all remaining encounters get surprise round against party. Major consequence.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Alchemist Fire Spreading!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A mitflit's crude alchemist fire spilled and ignites! Flames spread across wooden debris and old furniture! 'Sky King save us!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to smother flames, DC 18 Nature to create firebreak, or fire spreads
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Fire contained! 1d6 fire damage to nearby creatures.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Fire spreads! 3d6 fire damage per round! Smoke: DC 15 Fort or sickened 1!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflit alchemy gone wrong. Fire spreads 10ft per round. Smoke fills area in 3 rounds. Mitflits flee fire (cowardly). Wooden structures everywhere.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ambush from Above!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: 1d3 Darkmantles drop from the ceiling onto the party! The squid-like creatures were clinging to the stone, waiting in ambush. Tentacles reaching, ready to engulf!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Everyone makes DC 18 Perception check. Success = act in surprise round. Failure = flat-footed.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You noticed them falling. You can act in surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You're caught off-guard. Darkmantles get surprise round and attempt to engulf!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Darkmantle (Level 2, HP 30, AC 18). Engulf: DC 17 Reflex or engulfed (blinded, restrained). Darkness Aura: 10-foot radius. Surprise round is critical. Rewards high Perception.

key_abilities: Engulf: DC 17 Reflex or engulfed (blinded, restrained)

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Falling Debris!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The ceiling cracks and chunks of stone rain down on the party!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Reflex save to dodge. Take 2d6 bludgeoning damage on failure.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dodge the falling stones.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Take damage and must make DC 16 Fort save or be stunned 1.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Environmental hazard. Can happen anywhere. Keeps party alert.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Poison Gas Seeping!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Green mist pours from cracks in the walls. It smells toxic!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Nature to identify and find safe air, or DC 18 Fort save each round you stay
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You identify safe breathing technique or find clean air pocket.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Take 1d6 poison damage and become sickened 1. Worsens each round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Forces movement. Can't stay in this area. Escalating danger.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Flooding Chamber!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Water rushes in from broken pipes. The room is flooding rapidly!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Athletics to swim to exit before water fills room. DC 16 Perception to spot air pocket.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You reach the exit or find air pocket to breathe.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You're underwater. Hold breath or start drowning (DC 15 Fort each round).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Escalating danger. Eventually room is completely flooded. Must escape or drown.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Summoning Circle Activating!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A summoning circle on the floor glows brightly. Something is being summoned!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Arcana to disrupt ritual (3 actions) or prepare for combat
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Ritual disrupted. Nothing is summoned.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A creature appears! Roll initiative. It's hostile.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: If disrupted: avoid combat. If not: combat encounter with summoned creature.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Swarm Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Thousands of insects/rats/bats suddenly swarm from the walls!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Reflex to cover face, DC 18 Nature to repel them with fire/smoke
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You protect yourself. Swarm disperses.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Take 2d6 damage and become sickened 2 from bites and disease.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Sickened 2 = -2 to all checks. Very debilitating. Lasts until treated.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Sniper!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: An arrow whistles past your head! Someone is shooting from hiding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them, DC 18 Acrobatics to take cover
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot the sniper or reach cover. Can act normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Another arrow! Take 2d8 damage. Still don't know where they are.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Sniper has cover and concealment. Hard to fight back without spotting them.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Magical Explosion!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A magical trap detonates! Fireball erupts around you!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Reflex save or take 4d6 fire damage (half on success)
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dive aside. Take half damage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Full damage and catch fire (1d6 persistent fire damage).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Persistent fire requires action to extinguish. Major resource drain.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Tunnels Collapsing!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Crude mitflit tunnels collapse! Dirt and debris rain down! 'Sky King's domain falls!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Reflex to dodge, DC 18 Athletics to brace, or take damage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dodge or brace! Take half damage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Buried! 4d6 bludgeoning damage! DC 18 Athletics to dig out (3 actions)!
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round to escape, 3 rounds to dig out if buried
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflit construction is terrible. Collapse: 20ft radius. Buried: restrained until freed. May reveal hidden mitflit treasure. Loud noise alerts Boss Skrawng.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Reinforcements Arriving!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You hear chittering and squeaking! More mitflits rush to help their kin! 'Sky King! Sky King!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Intimidation to scare them off, or 1d4 more Mitflits arrive in 2 rounds
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They hear your roar and flee! No reinforcements.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They arrive! 1d4 more Mitflits join the fight!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Arrive in 2 rounds. If Boss Skrawng is alive, he may come too (10% chance). Cowardly if outnumbered.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hostage Situation!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Enemies have grabbed a civilian/ally and hold a knife to their throat!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Diplomacy to negotiate, DC 22 Intimidation to make them back down, or DC 19 ranged attack to shoot knife
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hostage is safe. Enemies surrender or flee.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hostage is killed. Enemies attack.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: High stakes. Failure has permanent consequences. Tests player judgment.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Magical Darkness Spreading!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Unnatural darkness spreads from a source, consuming all light!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Arcana to counter-spell, DC 18 Religion if unholy, or flee before engulfed
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Darkness is stopped or you escape its area.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Engulfed in darkness. Blinded. All creatures concealed. Can't target spells.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Blinded = -4 to Perception, flat-footed, 50% miss chance. Extremely dangerous.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Stampede!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Panicked creatures are stampeding toward you! Dozens of them!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Athletics to brace against wall, DC 19 Acrobatics to dodge, or DC 17 Nature to calm them
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You avoid the stampede or calm the creatures.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Trampled! Take 3d6 damage and knocked prone. Creatures keep running.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Prone in a stampede is very dangerous. Can be trampled multiple times.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Hunting Party Returns
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You hear guttural growls and dragging sounds. A morlock hunting party returns with captured prey (possibly another morlock for the ghouls). Heavy footsteps approach!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Stealth to hide OR DC 18 Intimidation to challenge them as 'Ghost Queen's agents'
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by or cower in fear. If intimidated, they drop their prey and flee.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'More meat for Ghost Queen!' Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2 specific. 1d3+1 morlocks carrying unconscious morlock. If intimidated, freed morlock may help later.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Guards Coming!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflit 'guards' (really just armed gremlins) rush to investigate! 'Protect Sky King's domain!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Intimidation to scare them, or they arrive
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or they flee! No combat.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They arrive! 1d3+1 Mitflits attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. 'Guards' are just mitflits with slightly better gear. Cowardly: flee if 2 die. May alert Boss Skrawng.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Patrol Approaching!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflits are coming down the corridor, chattering about 'Sky King's will'! You hear squeaking and maggot squelching!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Perception to prepare ambush, or they spot you
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or ready! You choose: ambush them or let them pass.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'Intruders!' 1d4 Mitflits attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Patrol route. If ambushed, they flee after 1 dies. If they escape, alert Boss Skrawng.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Incoming Mitflit Swarm!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You have seconds before they arrive! Dozens of mitflits swarm toward you, shrieking 'Sky King! Sky King!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to barricade, DC 18 Crafting to set trap, or face full swarm
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Barricade holds or trap triggers! Reduce swarm by half.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They pour in! 2d4 Mitflits attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Swarm tactics. Barricade: DC 18 Athletics for them to break. Trap: 3d6 damage to first wave. Cowardly if losing.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Librarian Patrol Seeks Flesh
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You hear shuffling and the smell of decay. Ghoul librarians from the Cult of the Canker patrol for 'cankerous flesh'. They're hunting morlocks. Footsteps approach rapidly!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Stealth to hide OR DC 19 Religion to invoke Nhimbaloth's name loudly
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by or pause at Nhimbaloth's name. 'The Empty Death watches...' they hiss and move on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'Fresh flesh for the golem!' Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3 specific. 1d3 ghouls with paralytic claws. Religion check shows deep Nhimbaloth knowledge. Seeking flesh for golem.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Sentries Coming!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Morlock sentries rush to investigate! 'Intruders in Ghost Queen's domain!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Intimidation to invoke Belcorra, or they arrive
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or they cower! No combat.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They arrive! 1d3 Morlocks attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Sentries guard Ghost Queen's territory. Invoking Belcorra may work. Darkvision 120ft. Swarming tactics.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Hunters Approaching!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Morlocks are coming down the corridor, dragging prey! You hear guttural growls and scraping!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Perception to prepare ambush, or they spot you
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or ready! You choose: ambush them or let them pass.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'More meat!' 1d3 Morlocks attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Dragging unconscious morlock to ghouls. If ambushed, freed morlock may help. Darkvision 120ft.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Incoming Morlock Horde!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You have seconds before they arrive! Morlocks howl and charge from darkness! 'Ghost Queen hungers!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to barricade, DC 18 Crafting to set trap, or face full horde
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Barricade holds or trap triggers! Reduce horde by half.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They crash in! 1d4+2 Morlocks attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Horde tactics. Swarming: +1 to hit if 2+ adjacent. Light sensitivity: bright light = -1. Darkvision 120ft.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Wight Commander and Undead Squad
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You hear armored footsteps and the rattle of bones. A wight commander leads a squad of skeletons on patrol. This is Belcorra's old guard, still following ancient orders!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Stealth to hide OR DC 18 Religion to command them as 'Belcorra's agents'
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by or halt at Belcorra's name. Wight salutes and continues patrol.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'Intruders in Belcorra's domain!' Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4 specific. 1 wight + 1d4 skeletons. Still following 500-year-old orders. Religion check invokes Belcorra's authority.
ACTIVE_THREAT.retired: Off-book: Floor 4 has two cairn wights (D12) and corpselight-ridden skeletons (D1), not wight squads or skeleton-guard patrols (floor-04). See etc/floor_ecology.json.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Guardians Coming!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ghoul guardians rush to investigate! 'Protect the Canker's work!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Religion to invoke Nhimbaloth, or they arrive
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or they pause! No combat.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They arrive! 1d3 Ghouls attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Cult of Canker guardians. Nhimbaloth invocation may pause them. Paralytic claws: DC 15 Fort. Ghoul fever risk.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Patrol Approaching!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ghouls are coming down the corridor, sniffing for flesh! You smell decay and hear shuffling!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Perception to prepare ambush, or they smell you
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or ready! You choose: ambush them or let them pass.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They smell you! 'Living flesh!' 1d3 Ghouls attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Cult of Canker patrol. Scent: +2 to find hidden creatures. Paralytic claws: DC 15 Fort.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Incoming Ghoul Pack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You have seconds before they arrive! Ghouls shamble rapidly toward you! 'Fresh flesh for the Canker!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to barricade, DC 18 Crafting to set trap, or face full pack
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Barricade holds or trap triggers! Reduce pack by half.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They burst in! 1d4 Ghouls attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Pack tactics. Paralytic claws: DC 15 Fort. Ghoul fever: DC 15 Fort. Cult of Canker seeks flesh for golem.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Seugathi Researchers Collecting Specimens
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You hear wet slithering and telepathic whispers. Seugathi researchers patrol for 'specimens' to fleshwarp. Their tentacles scrape stone. They approach rapidly!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Stealth to hide OR DC 18 Deception to claim you're 'new test subjects reporting to Jafaki'
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by or telepathically respond: 'Proceed to laboratory. Jafaki awaits.' They continue hunting.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They spot you! 'Perfect specimens!' Telepathic assault! Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6 specific. 1d3 seugathi. Telepathic communication. If deceived, they point toward Jafaki's lab.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Skeleton Guards Coming!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Skeleton guards march to investigate! Ancient protocols activated!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Religion to command as Belcorra's agents, or they arrive
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or they halt! No combat.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They arrive! 2d4 Skeletons attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Ancient guards following 500-year-old orders. Belcorra's name commands them. Weak to bludgeoning 5. Mindless.
ACTIVE_THREAT.retired: Off-book: Floor 4 has two cairn wights (D12) and corpselight-ridden skeletons (D1), not wight squads or skeleton-guard patrols (floor-04). See etc/floor_ecology.json.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Skeleton Guard Patrol Approaching!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Skeletons are coming down the corridor, marching in formation! You hear rattling bones and armor clanking!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Stealth to hide, DC 17 Perception to prepare ambush, or they see you
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Hidden or ready! You choose: ambush them or let them pass.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They see you! 'Intruders!' 2d4 Skeletons attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Ancient patrol route. Mindless but disciplined. Weak to bludgeoning 5. Following 500-year-old orders.

ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Arcana to dispel runes, or 1d2 Wights investigate in 2 rounds

ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Runes glow! 1d2 Wights arrive!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Magical warning system. Wights investigate. Can be permanently dispelled. Volluk alerted (10%).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ancient Alarm Going Off!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Belcorra's alarm wails! Runes pulse! Undead mobilize!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Arcana to dispel, or 1d3 Wights + 2d4 Skeletons march in 2 rounds
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Alarm dispelled!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Alarm wails! Undead march!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Magical alarm. Undead march. Volluk responds (15%). Drain Life. Belcorra's name commands them.
ACTIVE_THREAT.retired: Off-book: Floor 4 has two cairn wights (D12) and corpselight-ridden skeletons (D1), not wight squads or skeleton-guard patrols (floor-04). See etc/floor_ecology.json.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Arena Alarm Triggered!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger the arena alarm! Horns blast! 'Unauthorized in fighting pit!' Cratonys (velstrac) investigates!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to smash horns, DC 18 Intimidation to claim authority, or alarm continues
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Horns destroyed or claim accepted!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Horns blast! Cratonys arrives in 3 rounds! Arena beasts agitated!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Arena security system. Cratonys is feral but responds to alarms (500-year habit). Arena beasts panic. If shown Vaulgrist's whip, Cratonys stunned.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Seugathi Alert Sounding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Seugathi sound telepathic alert! Mental screams! 'Specimens escaping! Secure laboratory!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Occultism to block telepathy, DC 19 Deception to claim Jafaki's authority, or it continues
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Telepathy blocked! Seugathi confused.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Telepathic scream! 1d3 Seugathi + Jafaki (60% chance) arrive in 2 rounds!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Full telepathic alert (200ft range). Jafaki responds if in lab. All seugathi mobilize. Claiming Jafaki's authority works. May release experiments. Jafaki is BOSS.
ACTIVE_THREAT.threat_level: Extreme - telepathic alert + seugathi + boss chance

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Seugathi Warning System Activated!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Seugathi warning system pulses! Telepathic whisper: 'Unauthorized presence detected'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Occultism to block signal, or 1d2 Seugathi investigate in 2 rounds
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Signal blocked! No response.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Signal sent! 1d2 Seugathi arrive!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Telepathic warning (100ft range). Seugathi investigate. Can be permanently blocked. Jafaki alerted (40%).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Seugathi Alarm Going Off!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Seugathi alarm screams telepathically! 'Containment breach!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Occultism to block, or 1d3 Seugathi respond in 2 rounds
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Telepathy blocked!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Telepathic scream! 1d3 Seugathi respond!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Telepathic alarm (150ft). Seugathi respond. Jafaki responds (55%). Psychic Crush: 4d6 mental.
ACTIVE_THREAT.threat_level: Extreme - telepathic alarm + seugathi + boss chance

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Seugathi Alarm Triggered!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger seugathi security! Telepathic alarm screams! 'Unauthorized specimens detected! Secure the laboratory!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Occultism to block telepathy, DC 19 Deception to claim Jafaki sent you, or alarm continues
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Telepathy blocked or claim accepted!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Telepathic scream! 1d3 Seugathi arrive in 2 rounds! Jafaki alerted (50% chance)!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Telepathic alarm (100ft range). Seugathi respond quickly. Jafaki investigates if in lab. Claiming his authority works. May release experiments as distraction.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Ambush from Rafters!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflits drop from ceiling beams, shrieking 'For Sky King!' They throw crude bombs and stab with shortbows!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them first, or they get surprise round
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot them! Counter-ambush with surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They drop on you! 1d4+2 Mitflits attack with advantage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific. Mitflits in rafters. If spotted first, they flee after losing 2 members. Boss Skrawng may investigate.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Surprise Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You've walked into a mitflit trap! Tripwires trigger - crude bombs drop from ceiling!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot trap, DC 18 Reflex to dodge, or take 3d6 fire damage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot wires and dodge! 1d3 Mitflits flee, dropping loot.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: BOOM! 3d6 fire damage! Then 1d3 Mitflits attack from hiding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1 specific. Mitflit trap: 3d6 fire, 10ft radius. Mitflits attack if party survives. Loot: 2d10 copper, shiny junk.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hidden Mitflits Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflits hidden in debris suddenly attack! 'Sky King commands!' They throw alchemical items!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to spot them, or they attack with surprise
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot blue skin in shadows! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hidden attack! 1d4 Mitflits throw alchemist fire! 1d8 fire damage each!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Each has 1d3 alchemist fires. After throwing, attack with shortbows. Cowardly: flee if 2+ die.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Trap Sprung!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger a mitflit trap! Crude bombs drop from ceiling! 'Sky King's vengeance!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Reflex to dodge, DC 17 Perception to spot trigger, or take damage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dodge! Bombs explode harmlessly.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: BOOM! 3d6 fire damage! 10ft radius! DC 15 Reflex for half!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflit alchemy trap. Crude but effective. Fire spreads if near flammables. Noise alerts nearby mitflits (1d4 arrive in 2 rounds). Can be disarmed (DC 15 Thievery).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Ambush from Shadows!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Morlocks burst from dark alcoves, eyes glowing! They howl 'Ghost Queen hungers!' and attack with clubs!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them first, or they get surprise round
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot glowing eyes! Counter-ambush with surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They leap from darkness! 1d3+1 Morlocks attack with advantage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2 specific. Morlocks use darkvision advantage. Light-sensitive: -1 in bright light. May call for reinforcements.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Surprise Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You've walked into a morlock hunting ground! They drop nets from above!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot nets, DC 18 Reflex to dodge, or become restrained
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dodge nets! 1d3 Morlocks attack normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Netted! Restrained! 1d3 Morlocks attack with advantage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2 specific. Nets: Escape DC 18 Athletics/Acrobatics. Morlocks drag netted victims to ghouls. Restrained = flat-footed.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hidden Morlocks Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Morlocks hidden in darkness suddenly attack! Eyes glow as they charge with clubs!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to spot glowing eyes, or they attack with surprise
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see eyes in dark! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hidden attack! 1d3 Morlocks charge! Swarming attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Swarming: +1 to hit if 2+ adjacent to target. Light sensitivity: -1 in bright light. Darkvision 120ft.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Pit Trap Sprung!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger a morlock pit trap! Floor gives way! You fall into darkness! Morlocks wait below!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Reflex to grab edge, DC 17 Perception to spot trap, or fall
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch yourself! Climb up (DC 15 Athletics).
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You fall 20ft! 2d6 bludgeoning! 1d3 Morlocks attack from darkness!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Pit trap: 20ft deep. Morlocks have darkvision advantage. Climbing out: DC 15 Athletics. Morlocks drag victims to ghouls if they win.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Ambush from Corpse Pile!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ghouls hidden among corpses suddenly animate! 'Fresh flesh for the Canker!' Paralytic claws reach out!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them first, or they get surprise round
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You notice the 'corpses' breathing! Counter-ambush with surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They rise from the dead! 1d3 Ghouls attack with advantage! Paralysis risk!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3 specific. Cult of the Canker ghouls. Paralytic claws: DC 15 Fort save or paralyzed 1 round. Ghoul fever risk.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Surprise Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You've walked into a ghoul feeding ground! They burst from hidden alcoves, claws extended!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them, DC 18 Reflex to prepare, or they attack with advantage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You sense them! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Ambushed! 1d4 Ghouls attack with advantage! Paralysis risk!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3 specific. Cult of the Canker ambush. Paralytic claws: DC 15 Fort or paralyzed. Ghoul fever: DC 15 Fort or contract.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hidden Ghouls Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ghouls hidden among bookshelves suddenly attack! 'More flesh for the golem!' Claws extended!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to smell decay, or they attack with surprise
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You smell rot! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hidden attack! 1d3 Ghouls leap out! Paralysis risk!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Paralytic claws: DC 15 Fort or paralyzed 1 round. Ghoul fever: DC 15 Fort or contract disease. Cult of Canker.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Paralysis Trap Sprung!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger a ghoul trap! Poisoned needles shoot out! Cult of Canker alchemy!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Reflex to dodge, DC 17 Perception to spot trap, or take damage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dodge! Needles miss.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hit! 2d6 piercing + DC 17 Fort or paralyzed 1 minute! Ghouls arrive!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Paralysis poison trap. Ghouls hear trap trigger (arrive in 2 rounds). Paralyzed victims are helpless. Poison: ghoul saliva-based. Can be disarmed (DC 18 Thievery).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Wight Ambush from Alcoves!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Armored wights step from wall alcoves, ancient Belcorra guards! 'Intruders in our lady's domain!' Longswords raised!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them first, or they get surprise round
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see ancient armor move! Counter-ambush with surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They march forward! 1d2+1 Wights attack with advantage! Life drain risk!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4 specific. Belcorra's ancient guards. Drain Life on hit: 1d6 negative + drained 1. Undead, immune to death effects.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Skeleton Surprise Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You've walked into an ancient guard post! Skeletons animate from wall niches!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them, DC 18 Reflex to prepare, or they attack with advantage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You notice bones moving! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They animate! 2d4 Skeletons attack with advantage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4 specific. Belcorra's ancient guards. Weak individually but numerous. Resist slashing/piercing, weak to bludgeoning 5.
ACTIVE_THREAT.retired: Off-book: Floor 4 has two cairn wights (D12) and corpselight-ridden skeletons (D1), not wight squads or skeleton-guard patrols (floor-04). See etc/floor_ecology.json.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hidden Shadows Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Living shadows detach from walls! They reach with incorporeal claws to drain strength!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to notice moving shadows, or they attack with surprise
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see shadows move wrong! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hidden attack! 1d3 Shadows drain strength! 1d6 negative damage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Incorporeal: resist all except force/ghost touch. Strength Drain: 1d6 negative + enfeebled 1 (1 min). Sunlight powerless.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ancient Magic Trap Sprung!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger Belcorra's ancient trap! Runes explode with negative energy! 'Intruders shall wither!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Reflex to dodge, DC 19 Arcana to counter, or take damage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dodge or counter! Take half damage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Negative blast! 4d6 negative damage! DC 17 Fort or drained 1!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Belcorra's magic trap. Negative energy: heals undead, harms living. Drained 1: -1 to max HP until rest. Runes visible (DC 17 Perception). Can be dispelled (DC 19 Arcana).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Seugathi Ambush from Vents!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Seugathi slither from ventilation shafts! Telepathic assault: 'Perfect specimens!' Tentacles lash out!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them first, or they get surprise round
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You hear wet slithering! Counter-ambush with surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They drop from vents! 1d2+1 Seugathi attack with advantage! Mental damage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6 specific. Fleshwarper researchers. Psychic Crush: 4d6 mental damage, DC 24 Will. Telepathy 100ft. Seeking specimens.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Urdefhan Surprise Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You've walked into an urdefhan war party! They charge from concealment, weapons raised!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them, DC 18 Reflex to prepare, or they attack with advantage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You hear war chants! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Ambushed! 1d3 Urdefhan attack with advantage! Wicked bite!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9 specific. Khurfel's warriors. Wicked Bite: 1d8 piercing + 1d4 evil. Ferocity: don't fall unconscious at 0 HP (1 round).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hidden Driders Attack!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Driders hidden on ceiling suddenly drop! Webs shoot out as they descend with poisoned blades!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to look up, or they attack with surprise
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see webs above! Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hidden attack! 1d2 Driders drop! Web attack + poison!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Web: DC 24 Reflex or immobilized. Poison: DC 24 Fort, 2d6 poison + enfeebled 1. Seugathi allies.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Arena Beast Trap Sprung!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You trigger an arena trap! A cage door springs open! A starving Arena Beast (bulette) is released! This was for 'exciting matches'!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Perception to spot cage, DC 18 Nature to calm beast, or it attacks
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot it or calm it! Beast doesn't attack.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Beast released! Roll initiative! 1 random arena beast attacks!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5 specific. Trap releases 1 Arena Beast (Level 7, HP 130, AC 27). It's starving and enraged. DC 18 Nature to calm it (very difficult). Otherwise, roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.retired: Off-book: 'Arena Beasts' aren't in Abomination Vaults; Floor 5 is Jafaki's dumping ground for failed experiments (common/campaign-reference/floors/floor-05, Arena Features). See etc/floor_ecology.json.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Bearded Devil Ambush from Pillars!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Bearded devils emerge from behind pillars, chains rattling! 'Urevian's law is absolute!' Infernal glaives swing!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them first, or they get surprise round
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You smell brimstone! Counter-ambush with surprise round.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They charge from pillars! 1d3 Bearded Devils attack with advantage! Chain attacks!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7 specific. Urevian's enforcers. Beard: 1d6 slashing + 1d6 evil. Chains can grapple. Immune to fire, resist physical 5.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Torch Rack Fire Spreading!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ancient torch rack collapses, spreading fire across moldy tapestries! Morlocks howl in fear - they hate bright light!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to smother flames, DC 18 Survival to control spread, or fire spreads
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Fire contained! Morlocks flee the light.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Fire spreads! 3d6 fire damage per round! Bright light: morlocks take -1 penalty!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Ancient decorations are tinder. Fire spreads 10ft per round. Morlocks are light-sensitive: -1 in bright light. They flee fire AND light. May cause cave-in.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Alchemical Gas Leak!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflit alchemy gone wrong! Green gas leaks! 'Sky King save us!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Crafting to seal leak, DC 18 Athletics to escape, or breathe gas
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Leak sealed or you escape!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Gas spreads! 2d6 poison per round! DC 16 Fort or sickened 2!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflit alchemy disaster. Gas: 20ft radius, spreads 10ft per round. Sickened 2: -2 to all checks. Mitflits flee (cowardly). Flammable: ignites for 3d6 fire.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Tunnels Flooding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Water floods mitflit tunnels! 'Sky King's domain drowns!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to swim, DC 18 Survival to find high ground, or drown
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You swim or reach high ground!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Water rises! DC 16 Athletics to swim or 2d6 nonlethal per round! Mitflits drown!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Flooding tunnels. Water rises 5ft per round. Mitflits can't swim (drown). May reveal hidden passages. Boss Skrawng flees to surface.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Trap Expanding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflit trap triggers more traps! Chain reaction! 'Sky King's wrath!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Thievery to disable, DC 18 Reflex to dodge, or take damage
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Traps disabled or you dodge!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Chain reaction! 3d6 fire + 2d6 piercing! 20ft radius!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Chain trap. Triggers 1d4 more traps. Fire + caltrops. Mitflits flee (cowardly). May trigger Boss Skrawng's 'secret weapon' (giant maggot).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ancient Book Fire Spreading!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: 500-year-old books ignite from a knocked lantern! Ghouls shriek 'The Canker's knowledge!' as flames consume the library!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to smother flames, DC 18 Arcana to save magical texts, or fire spreads
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Fire contained! Save 1d4 valuable books (100gp each).
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Fire spreads! 3d6 fire damage per round! Ghouls attack in rage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Library fire. Ghouls ENRAGED at knowledge loss - attack anyone nearby. Fire spreads 15ft per round (paper fuel). Smoke: DC 15 Fort. May destroy quest items.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ancient Sewer Gas Leak!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: 500-year-old sewers leak toxic gas! Morlocks howl and flee!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Survival to find fresh air, DC 18 Athletics to seal breach, or breathe gas
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Fresh air found or breach sealed!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Gas spreads! 3d6 poison per round! DC 17 Fort or unconscious!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Sewer gas: deadly. Gas: 30ft radius, spreads 15ft per round. Unconscious: helpless. Morlocks flee (even they fear it). May ignite.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ancient Aqueduct Flooding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: 500-year-old aqueduct breaks! Water floods! Morlocks panic!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to swim, DC 18 Crafting to seal breach, or drown
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You swim or seal breach!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Water rises! DC 17 Athletics to swim or 3d6 nonlethal per round! Morlocks flee!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Aqueduct flood. Water rises 10ft per round. Morlocks flee (panic). May wash away to Floor 3. King Graulgust evacuates.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Cave-In Expanding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Cave-in spreads! Cracks race across ceiling! Morlocks flee!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to brace, DC 18 Acrobatics to escape, or buried
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You brace or escape!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Buried! 4d6 bludgeoning! DC 19 Athletics to dig out! Morlocks buried too!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Expanding cave-in. Spreads 20ft per round. Buries everyone (DC 19 Athletics to escape). Morlocks panic. May reveal hidden tunnels. King Graulgust evacuates.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Volluk's Alchemical Fire Spreading!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Volluk's old alchemical experiments ignite! Blue-green flames spread unnaturally! The fire seems almost alive!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Arcana to counter magic fire, DC 19 Athletics to smother, or fire spreads
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Fire contained! Magical flames extinguished.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Magical fire spreads! 4d6 fire damage per round! Fire ignores water!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Volluk's magical experiments. Fire is partially magical - water doesn't work. Spreads 10ft per round. Blue-green flames. May animate as fire elemental (10% chance).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Preservation Chemical Gas Leak!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Library preservation chemicals leak! Acrid fumes! Ghouls unaffected!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Crafting to neutralize, DC 18 Athletics to escape, or breathe gas
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Chemicals neutralized or you escape!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Gas spreads! 2d6 poison per round! DC 16 Fort or blinded!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Preservation chemicals. Gas: 20ft radius, spreads 10ft per round. Blinded: -4 to attacks/Perception. Ghouls immune (undead). Damages books.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Library Flooding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Water floods library! Books float! Ghouls shriek 'The knowledge!'
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to swim, DC 18 Perception to save books, or drown
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You swim or save 1d4 valuable books!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Water rises! DC 16 Athletics to swim or 2d6 nonlethal per round! Books destroyed!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Library flood. Water rises 5ft per round. Destroys books (quest items at risk). Ghouls ENRAGED. Nhakazarin investigates. Ink clouds water (concealment).
ACTIVE_THREAT.threat_level: High - drowning + book loss + ghoul rage

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Fire Expanding!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Library fire spreads! Books ignite! Ghouls rage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to smother, DC 18 Survival to create firebreak, or fire spreads
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Fire contained!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Fire spreads! 3d6 fire per round! 30ft radius! Ghouls attack in rage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Expanding fire. Spreads 20ft per round. Ghouls ENRAGED at knowledge loss. Smoke: DC 16 Fort or sickened. Nhakazarin investigates. May destroy quest items.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Arena Oil Fire Spreading!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Arena oil reserves ignite! Flames roar across the fighting pit! This was used to 'motivate' arena beasts!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 17 Athletics to close oil valves, DC 18 Acrobatics to dodge flames, or fire spreads
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Valves closed! Fire contained to pit.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Fire spreads! 4d6 fire damage per round! Oil flows: fire follows!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Arena oil system. Fire spreads along oil channels (20ft per round). Closing valves stops spread. Arena beasts panic and may break free. Smoke: DC 16 Fort.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Volluk's Alchemical Gas Leak!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Volluk's experiments leak! Blue-green gas! Smells like decay and magic!
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Arcana to counter magic, DC 19 Athletics to escape, or breathe gas
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Magic countered or you escape!
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Magical gas spreads! 3d6 poison + 2d6 negative per round! DC 18 Fort or drained 1!
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Volluk's magical gas. Gas: 20ft radius, spreads 10ft per round. Drained 1: -1 max HP. Negative energy: heals undead. May alert Volluk (30%).
ACTIVE_THREAT.threat_level: Extreme - magical poison + drained + boss alert

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Volluk's Leech Vat Overflowing!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Volluk's ritual vat overflows! Leeches pour out with water!

ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 18 Reflex save vs webs, DC 17 Perception to spot spiders
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Avoid webs or spot spiders before ambush.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Webbed (restrained) and 1d4 giant spiders attack with advantage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Webs require DC 16 Athletics or cutting to escape.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Reality Tears Open!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Space-time rips apart! Void energy pours through! Nhimbaloth's realm bleeds in!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 21 Occultism to close tear, DC 20 Will save vs void
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Close tear or resist void corruption.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Void creatures emerge (1d4), or corrupted (doomed 1, confused 1d4 rounds).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. Void creatures are dangerous. Doomed is very serious.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Nhimbaloth's Gaze!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You feel Nhimbaloth's attention! The Empty Death sees you!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 22 Will save to resist, DC 21 Occultism to shield mind
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Resist gaze or shield yourself.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Paralyzed with fear (stunned 1d4 rounds), or doomed 2.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. Nhimbaloth's attention is terrifying. Stunned is deadly in combat.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Mitflit Bomb Barrage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mitflits throw crude bombs from above! Explosions everywhere!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 16 Reflex save to dodge, DC 17 Perception to spot throwers
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Dodge bombs or spot and stop throwers.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hit by bombs: 3d6 fire damage, possibly knocked prone.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. 1d6 mitflits throwing. Bombs are crude but effective.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Skeleton Ambush!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Skeletons burst from alcoves! Rusty weapons raised!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 17 Perception to detect, DC 16 Initiative to act first
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: No surprise round, or act before skeletons.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Surprised - skeletons get free attacks.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. 1d4+1 skeletons. Mindless but dangerous.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Morlock Berserker!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A massive morlock berserker charges! Eyes wild with rage!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 17 Athletics to brace, DC 18 Acrobatics to dodge
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Brace for impact (reduce damage) or dodge completely.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Hit by charge: 3d6 damage, knocked prone, berserker has advantage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Berserker is level+1. Rage gives it +2 damage.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Ghoul Paralysis Trap!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ghoul claws coated with extra toxin! One touch and you're frozen!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 18 Fortitude save vs paralysis, DC 17 Medicine to treat
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Resist paralysis or treat immediately.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Paralyzed for 1d4 rounds - helpless while ghouls feast.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Paralysis is deadly. Ghouls coup de grace paralyzed victims.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Werewolf Frenzy!
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A werewolf enters blood frenzy! It's unstoppable!
ACTIVE_THREAT.challenge: DC 18 Intimidation to snap it out, DC 17 Athletics to restrain
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: End frenzy or restrain werewolf.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frenzied werewolf attacks: +4 to attack/damage, ignores pain.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Frenzy lasts 1d4+1 rounds. Werewolf is level+1 while frenzied.
